definition_en: to make an effort to do something, or to test something to see whether it works
core_image: 一个人踮起脚去够高架子最上层的那只盒子
scene: 厨房的吊柜太高，个子矮的人伸手够不着最里面那只盒子。She tried again and again until her fingers touched the box.
sceneCN: 这里 try 是「尝试；努力」（第 1 个义项：付出力气去做一件不容易做到的事）；句意为她一次又一次地试，直到手指碰到那只盒子。踮脚去够高处盒子的动作，就是这个词的样子。

derivatives.zh: 由 try 同源的 trial 构成，义为「试验；审判」
由 try 加 -ing 构成，义为「难熬的；考验人的」
由 try 加 -er 构成，义为「努力尝试的人」

senses.title: The reaching hand
senses.definition: to make an effort to do something difficult
senses.definitionCN: 付出力气去做一件不容易做到的事
senses.example: She tried to lift the box but it was too heavy.
senses.exampleCN: 她试着抬起那只箱子，但它太重了。
senses.why: The core of the word is effort spent on something that may fail.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的核心是把力气花在一件可能失败的事情上。

senses.title: The small test
senses.definition: to use or do something briefly in order to find out whether it is good
senses.definitionCN: 短暂地使用或做某事，以判断它是否合适
senses.example: Try this soup and tell me if it needs more salt.
senses.exampleCN: 尝尝这汤，告诉我是不是还要加点盐。
senses.why: Testing is effort made cheap: you risk little and learn a lot.
senses.whyCN: 试用的本质是廉价的努力：冒很小的风险，换回很多信息。

senses.title: One go at it
senses.definition: an attempt, counted as one of several
senses.definitionCN: 作为若干次中的一次而努力
senses.example: It took him three tries before the door opened.
senses.exampleCN: 他试了三次，门才开。
senses.why: The verb turns into a countable noun, so attempts can be numbered.
senses.whyCN: 动词转成可数名词，于是尝试可以被数出来。

senses.title: The courtroom
senses.definition: to examine a case and decide whether someone is guilty
senses.definitionCN: 审理案件并裁定某人是否有罪
senses.example: The case will be tried in the county court next month.
senses.exampleCN: 此案将于下月在郡法院审理。
senses.why: A court also puts a case to the test, which is why the legal sense grew from the same idea.
senses.whyCN: 法庭同样是在对案件加以检验，法律义便由同一个观念长出。

intro.en: Try came into English from Old French trier, to sift or pick out, a word whose own origin is much debated.
intro.cn: try 来自古法语 trier（筛、挑选），而这个词本身的来源众说纷纭。

items.en: Trier meant to sift grain, separating the good from the bad.
items.cn: 古法语 trier 意为筛谷，把好的与坏的分开。

items.en: English borrowed it as trien, to examine or to sift a matter.
items.cn: 英语借入作 trien，意为审查或筛选一件事。

items.en: From examining a matter came the legal sense: to try a case in court.
items.cn: 由审查一件事生出法律义：在法庭上审理案件。

items.en: The everyday sense of attempting something grew out of the idea of putting it to the test.
items.cn: 日常的「尝试」义由「加以检验」这一观念发展而来。

items.en: Today try covers effort, experiment and trial at law, all bound by the act of testing.
items.cn: 今天 try 兼指努力、试验与审判，三者都由「检验」这一动作连在一起。

note.en: The first group collects words that look like try, the second collects closer meanings.
note.cn: 第一组收形近词，第二组收义近词。

entries.definition: A formal test or a court hearing.
A group of people who share ancestry.
To make an effort at something.
To work hard towards a goal.
To check how well something works.

normalIntro.en: Try is short and blunt: one syllable holding a whole handful of effort.
normalIntro.cn: try 短促干脆：一个音节里装了一整把力气。

normal.en: The y changes to i before -es and -ed: tries, tried.
normal.cn: 加 -es、-ed 时 y 变 i：tries、tried。

normal.en: Try takes a to-infinitive when it means effort: try to open it.
normal.cn: 表示努力时后接不定式：try to open it。

normal.en: Try plus a gerund means an experiment: try opening it.
normal.cn: 后接动名词则表示试验：try opening it。

normal.en: Trial and try come from the same French root.
normal.cn: trial 与 try 同出法语词根。

normal.en: The court sense keeps the old idea of testing a case.
normal.cn: 法庭义保留了检验案件的古老观念。

abstract.en: A hand stretched towards a shelf just out of reach.
abstract.cn: 一只伸向刚好够不着的架子的手。

abstract.en: A spoon lifted to the lips with a doubtful face.
abstract.cn: 一把迟疑地送到唇边的勺子。

abstract.en: Three chalk marks on a door frame, one for each failure.
abstract.cn: 门框上三道粉笔痕，一次失败一道。

examples.en: Try to keep your voice low in the library.
examples.cn: 在图书馆里尽量把声音压低。

examples.en: She tried the new keyboard and liked it at once.
examples.cn: 她试了新键盘，立刻就喜欢上了。

examples.en: After two failed tries he found the right key.
examples.cn: 失败了两次之后，他找到了对的那把钥匙。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踹」——把门踹开得使劲，一次不行就再踹一次，就是努力尝试。

root: 源自中古英语 trien、古法语 trier（筛、挑），本义为把好坏分开、对事物加以检验，由此生出努力尝试、试用与法庭审判三义，同族词有 trial。

sensesIntro.en: From effort, through testing, to one counted attempt, and finally to the courtroom where a case is tested.
sensesIntro.cn: 从付出努力，到试用检验，再到可数的一次尝试，最后落到检验案件的法庭。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand reaching for a high shelf.
core.cn: 核心意象：伸向高处架子的手。

branches.en: The effort branch: the hand keeps reaching.
branches.cn: 努力分支：手一直往上够。

branches.en: The sample branch: a small taste before deciding.
branches.cn: 样品分支：先尝一口再决定。

branches.en: The count branch: attempts numbered like steps.
branches.cn: 计数分支：尝试像台阶一样被数出来。

branches.en: The test branch: effort shared by court and kitchen.
branches.cn: 检验分支：法庭与厨房共用同一份力气。

branches.en: The judgement branch: tasting and ruling both decide.
branches.cn: 判断分支：品尝与裁决都在做决定。

intro.en: Try is a free root of Romance origin, and the family grows with -al and -ing.
intro.cn: try 是源自罗曼语的自由词根，词族靠 -al、-ing 扩展。

latinIntro.en: The deeper source of the French verb is uncertain, so the list below stays close to the English family.
latinIntro.cn: 这个法语动词更深一层的来源尚无定论，因此下列条目限于英语词族本身。

items.meaning: he or she makes an effort

items.example: It also forms the adjective trying.

definition_en: a long passage dug under the ground or through a hill, or the act of digging one
core_image: 山腹里一条两头透光的圆孔，汽车正从中间穿过
scene: 火车钻进山里，车窗外的光先暗下去，又在前方亮起来。The tunnel runs for nine kilometres under the mountain.
sceneCN: 这里 tunnel 是「隧道」（第 1 个义项：在地下山体中挖出的长通道）；句意为这条隧道在山下延伸九公里。两头透光的山腹圆孔，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 tunnel 加 -ing 构成，义为「隧道开凿」
由 tunnel 加 -er 构成，义为「隧道工人」
由 tunnel 加 -ed 构成，义为「挖了隧道的」

senses.title: The hole through the hill
senses.definition: a passage cut through earth or rock, usually for traffic
senses.definitionCN: 在土石中开凿出的通道，通常供交通使用
senses.example: The tunnel runs for nine kilometres under the mountain.
senses.exampleCN: 这条隧道在山下延伸九公里。
senses.why: The word names the hollow shape itself, a tube pushed through solid ground.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名的正是那个中空的形状：一根被推过实地里的管子。

senses.title: The animal burrow
senses.definition: a hole dug by a small animal for shelter
senses.definitionCN: 小动物为藏身挖出的洞道
senses.example: Rabbits had made a tunnel beneath the hedge.
senses.exampleCN: 兔子在树篱下挖了一条洞道。
senses.why: A rabbit performs the same act of pushing a passage, so the word covers its home too.
senses.whyCN: 兔子做的也是推出一条通道这件事，于是它们的家也叫 tunnel。

senses.title: The digging itself
senses.definition: to make a passage by digging through earth, or to move as if through one
senses.definitionCN: 挖掘地道穿过土石，或像钻洞一样前行
senses.example: Workers tunnelled through the cliff to reach the harbour.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们穿凿崖壁，好把路通到港口。
senses.why: The noun turns into a verb, so the passage and the act of making it share one word.
senses.whyCN: 名词转作动词，于是通道与开凿通道的动作共用同一个词。

intro.en: Tunnel is a diminutive of Old French ton, a barrel, because the first tunnels were round like a cask.
intro.cn: tunnel 是古法语 ton（木桶）的指小词，因为最早的隧道像横放的酒桶。

items.en: Ton meant a tun or barrel, a round hollow vessel made of staves.
items.cn: ton 意为大桶，是用板条箍成的圆形空器。

items.en: English took the diminutive tunel and first used it for a bird net shaped like a funnel.
items.cn: 英语借入指小形式 tunel，起初指漏斗状的捕鸟网。

items.en: The name shifted to the shaft or pipe through which something passes.
items.cn: 名称转指某物穿过的竖井或管道。

items.en: With canal and railway building it settled on a passage bored through earth.
items.cn: 随着运河与铁路的修建，词义固定为穿过土石的通道。

items.en: The verb followed, so to tunnel means to push out a cask-shaped passage.
items.cn: 动词随后出现，to tunnel 即推出一条桶状的通道。

note.en: The first group holds words sharing the barrel shape or the sound, the second holds other passages.
note.cn: 第一组收与桶形或读音相关的词，第二组收其他表示通道的词。

entries.definition: A melody or a set adjustment.
A way through or along something.
An underground railway or a walkway below a road.
A hole dug by an animal.

normalIntro.en: Tunnel carries the shape of a barrel inside its history and of a tube in its sound.
normalIntro.cn: tunnel 的历史里藏着桶形，读音里又藏着管子的样子。

normal.en: Double the l before -ed and -ing in British spelling.
normal.cn: 英式拼写中加 -ed、-ing 时双写 l。

normal.en: The stress is on the first syllable: TUN-nel.
normal.cn: 重音在第一个音节。

normal.en: Funnel and tunnel differ by one letter and both are hollow.
normal.cn: funnel 与 tunnel 只差一个字母，都是空心的。

normal.en: A tunnel has two mouths, one at each end.
normal.cn: 隧道有两口，一头一个。

normal.en: To tunnel is to make the noun with your hands.
normal.cn: to tunnel 就是用手把这个名词造出来。

abstract.en: A ring of daylight far ahead in the dark.
abstract.cn: 黑暗中远处一圈天光。

abstract.en: A rabbit hole sloping down under a hedge.
abstract.cn: 树篱下斜下去的一个兔洞。

abstract.en: Two lamps entering the rock and not coming out.
abstract.cn: 两盏灯进了岩层就没再出来。

examples.en: The tunnel was closed for repairs all weekend.
examples.cn: 隧道整个周末都在维修封闭。

examples.en: Engineers tunnelled beneath the river in only two years.
examples.cn: 工程师们只用两年就在河底挖通了隧道。

examples.en: A faint light showed at the end of the tunnel.
examples.cn: 隧道尽头透出一点微光。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吞哪」——火车一口把人和车吞进山肚子里，走的是隧道。

root: 源自中古英语 tunel、古法语 ton（大桶）的指小形式，本义为桶状的空心物，后指穿过土石的通道，同族词有 funnel、tun。

sensesIntro.en: First the passage through rock, then the smaller burrow of an animal, then the act of digging one.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是穿石的通道，再是动物的洞穴，最后是开凿这个动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tube of light through solid rock.
core.cn: 核心意象：穿透实岩的一管光。

branches.en: The passage branch: traffic moving through rock.
branches.cn: 通道分支：车辆穿过岩层。

branches.en: The animal branch: a smaller version of the same hole.
branches.cn: 动物分支：同一个洞的缩小版。

branches.en: The action branch: hands making the passage.
branches.cn: 动作分支：双手挖出通道。

branches.en: The engineering branch: plans become a bored tube.
branches.cn: 工程分支：图纸变成钻出的管道。

branches.en: The escape branch: a burrow used to get out.
branches.cn: 逃亡分支：用来逃出的地道。

intro.en: Tunnel is a stem plus the old dimunitive ending -el, and the family grows with -ing and -er.
intro.cn: tunnel 由词干加古老的指小后缀构成，词族靠 -ing、-er 扩展。

latinIntro.en: The French source goes back to a barrel word, and the related Latin forms are listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 其法语来源可追到一个表示桶的词，相关拉丁形式列在下面。

items.exampleCN: 挖隧道的工人头上戴着灯。

items.meaning: a small one of the stem

items.example: Pour the oil through a funnel.

definition_en: a machine with a wheel that is spun by steam, gas or water in order to produce power
core_image: 水流冲击一圈金属叶片，轮轴在轰鸣中飞速旋转
scene: 水坝底部的机房里，水从高处冲下来，推动一整排金属轮子。Each turbine in the plant can light a small town.
sceneCN: 这里 turbine 是「涡轮机」（第 1 个义项：靠蒸汽、燃气或水流冲转轮子来产生动力的机器）；句意为厂里每台涡轮机都能照亮一座小镇。水流冲击叶片、轮轴狂转的画面，就是这个词的样子。

derivatives.zh: 由 turbine 附近的词干构成，义为「陀螺状的」
由 turbine 加 driven 构成，义为「涡轮驱动的」
turbine 的缩略形式，义为「涡轮；涡轮增压器」

senses.title: The spinning wheel
senses.definition: a machine whose wheel is turned by a moving fluid, changing that motion into power
senses.definitionCN: 靠流动的流体带动轮子旋转、把转动变成动力的机器
senses.example: Each turbine in the plant can light a small town.
senses.exampleCN: 厂里每台涡轮机都能照亮一座小镇。
senses.why: The name points at the wheel itself, the part that turns.
senses.whyCN: 词名直指那个轮子，那个真正在转的部件。

senses.title: The engine built around it
senses.definition: a whole engine, as in a jet, that works by driving such a wheel
senses.definitionCN: 如喷气机中围着一个涡轮工作的整台发动机
senses.example: The aircraft is fitted with a new turbine.
senses.exampleCN: 这架飞机装有新型涡轮发动机。
senses.why: Because the wheel is the heart of the engine, the part name came to stand for the whole.
senses.whyCN: 轮子是发动机的心脏，于是部件的名字代替了整体。

intro.en: Turbine was coined in the nineteenth century from the Latin word for a whirl, turbinis.
intro.cn: turbine 是十九世纪用拉丁语中表示「漩涡」的词 turbinis 造出来的。

items.en: Turbo meant a whirl or a spinning top, and its genitive turbinis named the whirling thing.
items.cn: turbo 意为漩涡或陀螺，其属格 turbinis 命名旋转之物。

items.en: French engineers used the Latin stem in the vocabulary of early hydraulic machinery.
items.cn: 法国工程师在早期水力机械的词汇里用上了这个拉丁词干。

items.en: In the eighteen twenties the word was given to a wheel spun by water.
items.cn: 十九世纪二十年代，这个词被赋予被水流冲转的轮子。

items.en: Steam engines then used turbines for a far greater spinning force.
items.cn: 蒸汽机随后用涡轮机取得大得多的旋转力。

items.en: Jets and power stations made it an everyday word for a machine that whirls.
items.cn: 喷气机与电站使它成为「旋转的机器」的日常用词。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin whirl, the second names power machines.
note.cn: 第一组共享拉丁语「旋转」词根，第二组是动力机器的名称。

entries.definition: The turning part of a machine.

normalIntro.en: Turbine and turbulence come from the same Latin whirl, so the machine is a tame tempest.
normalIntro.cn: turbine 与 turbulence 同出拉丁语的「旋转」，所以这台机器是一头被驯服的旋风。

normal.en: The second syllable carries the stress in British speech: TUR-bine.
normal.cn: 英式发音重音多在第二音节。

normal.en: Turbine shares its stem with disturb and turbulence.
normal.cn: turbine 与 disturb、turbulence 共享词干。

normal.en: A turbine turns a flow of fluid into a turn of the shaft.
normal.cn: 涡轮机把流体的流动变成轴的转动。

normal.en: Turbo is the clipped, faster form of the same word.
normal.cn: turbo 是同一个词的缩略快读形式。

normal.en: Nothing spins without blades, so picture the blades first.
normal.cn: 没有叶片什么也转不起来，先想叶片。

abstract.en: A ring of blades catching a column of water.
abstract.cn: 一圈叶片接住一股水柱。

abstract.en: A whirlpool seen from above, frozen in metal.
abstract.cn: 从上方看去的漩涡，凝在金属里。

abstract.en: The low hum of a hall full of spinning wheels.
abstract.cn: 一屋子里满是转轮的低声轰鸣。

examples.en: Wind turbines line the ridge above the village.
examples.cn: 风力涡轮机排在小村上方的山脊上。

examples.en: A damaged turbine can cut the station's output by half.
examples.cn: 一台受损的涡轮机能让电站发电量减半。

examples.en: The turbine spins thousands of times a minute.
examples.cn: 这台涡轮机每分钟转几千次。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「特别一拧」——一拧开就疯狂旋转，正是涡轮机。

root: 来自拉丁语 turbo（漩涡、陀螺）的属格 turbinis，本义为旋转之物，十九世纪用以称呼被水流或蒸汽冲转的轮子，同族词有 turbulence、disturb、turbo。

sensesIntro.en: First the spinning wheel, then the whole engine built around that wheel.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是那个在转的轮子，再是围着这个轮子造出的整台发动机。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: water striking a ring of blades.
core.cn: 核心意象：水撞上一圈叶片。

branches.en: The wheel branch: fluid turned into spin.
branches.cn: 轮子分支：流体变为旋转。

branches.en: The engine branch: the whole machine takes the part's name.
branches.cn: 发动机分支：整体借用了部件的名字。

branches.en: The power branch: spin becomes electricity.
branches.cn: 电力分支：旋转变成电。

branches.en: The wind branch: air does the same work as water.
branches.cn: 风分支：空气做着与水相同的工作。

branches.en: The flight branch: a jet rides on its turbines.
branches.cn: 飞行分支：喷气机靠涡轮飞行。

intro.en: Turbine is a Latin stem with a noun ending, and its relatives cluster around the idea of whirling.
intro.cn: turbine 是带名词词尾的拉丁词干，其亲属词都围绕「旋转」聚拢。

latinIntro.en: Latin turbo and its family supplied several English words about disturbing and whirling.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 turbo 及其词族贡献了若干表示搅动与旋转的英语词。

items.exampleCN: 它收束了 turbine 这个词。

definition_en: to move around a centre, to change direction, or to become something different
core_image: 门把手上的一只手轻轻一拧，门就开了
scene: 走廊尽头，探访者站在门前犹豫了一会儿。She turned the handle slowly and the door swung open.
sceneCN: 这里 turn 是「转动」（第 1 个义项：绕着一个中心旋转）；句意为她慢慢转动门把手，门就开了。手拧门把的那一下，就是这个词最本真的样子。

derivatives.zh: 由 turn 加 -ing 构成，义为「转弯处；转向」
由 turn 与 out 合成，义为「出席人数」
由 turn 加前缀 over 构成，义为「使翻倒；推翻」
由 turn 加前缀 re 构成，义为「返回」

senses.title: The handle
senses.definition: to move something round a fixed point
senses.definitionCN: 使某物绕着固定的一点旋转
senses.example: She turned the handle slowly and the door swung open.
senses.exampleCN: 她慢慢转动门把手，门就开了。
senses.why: The oldest sense is pure motion around a centre, with nothing else implied.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的含义就是绕中心旋转的纯动作，不带别的意味。

senses.title: The corner
senses.definition: to change the direction in which you face or move
senses.definitionCN: 改变朝向或行进的方向
senses.example: Turn right after the bridge and you will see the school.
senses.exampleCN: 过了桥向右转，你就能看见学校。
senses.why: Turning the body repeats the same motion on a larger scale.
senses.whyCN: 身体转向，不过是把同一个动作放大到整个人身上。

senses.title: The change of state
senses.definition: to become something else, often slowly
senses.definitionCN: 逐渐变成另一种样子
senses.example: The leaves turned yellow in a single cold week.
senses.exampleCN: 一场寒流过后，叶子一周就黄了。
senses.why: If a thing can turn, it can also turn into another shape, so the verb came to mean change.
senses.whyCN: 既然能转，就能转成另一副样子，于是这个动词获得了「改变」的意思。

senses.title: The rightful moment
senses.definition: the time when it is your chance to do something
senses.definitionCN: 该你做事的那一段时间
senses.example: It is your turn to choose the music.
senses.exampleCN: 轮到你选音乐了。
senses.why: Turns go round in a circle, back to each person in order.
senses.whyCN: 轮流本就是绕圈子来的，一圈后再回到每个人。

intro.en: Turn came from Old French torner, and behind it stands the Latin and Greek word for a lathe that spins wood.
intro.cn: turn 来自古法语 torner，再往上是拉丁语与希腊语中表示旋木车床的词。

items.en: Tornos named a lathe, a tool that spins wood against a blade.
items.cn: tornos 指车床，即让木料转着碰刀的工具。

items.en: Tornare took the meaning to turn, and the noun tornus named a circuit.
items.cn: tornare 取得「转」的含义，名词 tornus 指一圈。

items.en: Torner meant to turn, roll or change direction.
items.cn: torner 意为转、滚、改变方向。

items.en: Turne covered turning the body, turning a page, and turning into something.
items.cn: turne 涵盖转身、翻页和变成某物。

items.en: From the order of turns came the noun sense of a person's chance.
items.cn: 从轮转的次序生出名词义：一个人轮到的机会。

note.en: The first group shares the stem, the second collects other verbs of motion.
note.cn: 第一组共享词干，第二组收其他表示运动的动词。

entries.definition: To come back to a place.
A corner or a point of change.
To turn quickly again and again.

normalIntro.en: Turn is the plain English word for going round, whether a handle, a head or a season.
normalIntro.cn: turn 是最朴素的「转」，门把、脑袋、季节都用它。

normal.en: Turn plus into means to become: water turns into ice.
normal.cn: 接 into 表示变成：water turns into ice。

normal.en: Turn on and turn off work for lights and machines.
normal.cn: 开关灯、开关机器用 turn on 和 turn off。

normal.en: Take turns comes from the round of a circle.
normal.cn: take turns 的轮流出自绕圈。

normal.en: The n is silent after the vowel in rapid speech, but not in writing.
normal.cn: 口语连读时 n 很轻，书写不可省。

normal.en: Return carries the same turning, only back.
normal.cn: return 带着同一个转，只是方向往回。

abstract.en: A palm pressing a brass handle down.
abstract.cn: 一只手掌把铜门把压下去。

abstract.en: A road bending out of sight behind a wall.
abstract.cn: 一条路在墙后拐出视野。

abstract.en: Leaves turning from green to gold.
abstract.cn: 叶子由绿转金。

examples.en: He turned the key twice before the lock gave way.
examples.cn: 他拧了两下钥匙，锁才开。

examples.en: Turn left at the fountain and follow the crowd.
examples.cn: 在喷泉处左转，跟着人群走。

examples.en: The wind turned cold the moment the sun went down.
examples.cn: 太阳一落，风就变冷了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「腾」——一腾身就转过身去，转、转弯都是它。

root: 源自中古英语 turne、古法语 torner，再上溯拉丁语 tornare、希腊语 tornos（车床），本义为绕圈旋转，同族词有 return、turning、turnout。

sensesIntro.en: Motion round a centre first, then a change of direction, then a change of nature, and last the chance that comes round.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是绕心的转动，再是方向改变，再是性质改变，最后是绕回来的机会。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand turning a door handle.
core.cn: 核心意象：手拧门把。

branches.en: The pivot branch: one point stays still.
branches.cn: 支点分支：一个点不动。

branches.en: The direction branch: the body follows the hand.
branches.cn: 方向分支：身体跟着手转。

branches.en: The change branch: turning becomes becoming.
branches.cn: 变化分支：转变成「变成」。

branches.en: The order branch: turns go round and come back.
branches.cn: 次序分支：转圈后回到原处。

branches.en: The cycle branch: a handle and a rota both turn.
branches.cn: 循环分支：门把与值班表都在转。

intro.en: Turn is a free root from French, and its family grows through prefixes such as re- and over-.
intro.cn: turn 是来自法语自由词根，其词族靠 re-、over- 等前缀扩展。

latinIntro.en: Latin tornare, to turn, yields the whole family, listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tornare（转）生出整个词族，列在下面。

definition_en: a teacher who works with one student or a small group, or to teach in this way
core_image: 书桌两侧对坐的两个人，一个讲一道题，一个握笔在算
scene: 放学后的图书馆角落，两名学生隔着桌子低声讨论数学。His tutor showed him a shorter way to solve the equation.
sceneCN: 这里 tutor 是「家庭教师；导师」（第 1 个义项：单独或小班辅导学生的老师）；句意为他的导师教他一种更短的解题方法。两人隔着书桌对坐的画面，就是这个词的样子。

derivatives.zh: 由 tutor 加 -ial 构成，义为「辅导课」
由同一拉丁词根构成，义为「学费；教学」
由 tutor 加 -ing 构成，义为「辅导工作」

senses.title: The one beside you
senses.definition: a teacher who gives lessons to one learner or a small group
senses.definitionCN: 给一名学生或一小群人单独授课的老师
senses.example: His tutor showed him a shorter way to solve the equation.
senses.exampleCN: 他的导师教他一种更短的解题方法。
senses.why: A tutor is close enough to watch one person think, which is what separates the role from a class teacher.
senses.whyCN: 家教近到能看着一个人思考，这正是它区别于班级教师的地方。

senses.title: The guide at college
senses.definition: a member of staff who advises a student on study and progress
senses.definitionCN: 在大学里就学业与进度指导学生的工作人员
senses.example: Every first-year student is assigned a tutor.
senses.exampleCN: 每位一年级学生都分配一位导师。
senses.why: The university kept the word for the person who guards a student's course, not just one subject.
senses.whyCN: 大学保留这个词，指照看学生整个课程而不只是某一科的人。

senses.title: The act of guiding
senses.definition: to teach one person or a few people, often outside school
senses.definitionCN: 常在校外对一人或数人进行教学
senses.example: She tutors two children in reading on Saturdays.
senses.exampleCN: 她每周六给两个孩子辅导阅读。
senses.why: The noun becomes a verb: to be the tutor is to do what a tutor does.
senses.whyCN: 名词转动词：当导师就是做导师该做的事。

intro.en: Tutor comes from Latin tueri, to watch over, the same root as tutelage and tuition.
intro.cn: tutor 来自拉丁语 tueri（看守、守护），与 tutelage、tuition 同根。

items.en: Tueri meant to look after or guard someone or something.
items.cn: tueri 意为照看、守护某人或某物。

items.en: Tutor named the guardian, the one who watches over another.
items.cn: tutor 指守护者，即看护他人的人。

items.en: French carried tutor in the sense of a legal guardian.
items.cn: 法语传入 tutor 时带有法定监护人的意思。

items.en: English used it for a guardian before it became a word for a teacher.
items.cn: 英语先把它用作监护人，后来才转为教师。

items.en: The teaching sense won: the one who guards a learner now guards the learning.
items.cn: 教学义胜出：守护学习者的人，如今守护的是学习本身。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin root, the second names other teaching roles.
note.cn: 第一组共享拉丁词根，第二组是其他教学角色。

entries.definition: Teaching, or the fee for it.
The care of a guardian or teacher.
A person who teaches a class.

normalIntro.en: Tutor keeps the old meaning of guarding: the teacher who watches over one learner.
normalIntro.cn: tutor 保留着守护的古义：盯着一个学生学的老师。

normal.en: Tutor, tuition and tutelage all start from the same Latin watch.
normal.cn: tutor、tuition、tutelage 都起自同一个拉丁语的「看」。

normal.en: The British stress is on the first syllable, the American one is closer to too.
normal.cn: 英式重音在前，美式首元音近于 too。

normal.en: As a verb it takes an object and often in: tutor him in maths.
normal.cn: 作动词时常接 in：tutor him in maths。

normal.en: A tutor teaches one, a class teacher teaches many.
normal.cn: 家教教一个，班级教师教一群。

normal.en: Tutorial is the session, tutor is the person.
normal.cn: tutorial 是课，tutor 是人。

abstract.en: Two chairs pulled close to one desk.
abstract.cn: 两把椅子拉到同一张桌子旁。

abstract.en: A pencil marking the same sum a second time.
abstract.cn: 一支铅笔把同一道题再标一遍。

abstract.en: A lamp left on over a late page.
abstract.cn: 深夜仍亮在某页书上的灯。

examples.en: Her parents found a tutor for the final term.
examples.cn: 她父母为最后一个学期请了家教。

examples.en: He tutors village children in maths for free.
examples.cn: 他免费给村里的孩子辅导数学。

examples.en: My tutor asked whether I had chosen a topic yet.
examples.cn: 我的导师问我是否已经选好题目。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「兔特」——老师像盯着兔子一样盯着一个学生学，就是家教。

root: 源自中古英语 tutour、古法语 tutor，上溯拉丁语 tutor（守护者）与动词 tueri（看守），本义为看护学习的人，同族词有 tuition、tutorial、tutelage。

sensesIntro.en: First the teacher who sits beside one learner, then the university guide, then the act of doing that work.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是坐在一个学生旁边的老师，再是大学里的导师，最后是做这件事本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two chairs drawn up to one desk.
core.cn: 核心意象：两把椅子拉到同一张桌边。

branches.en: The near teacher branch: one desk, one learner.
branches.cn: 近身教师分支：一桌一学生。

branches.en: The guardian branch: the college keeps the old watch.
branches.cn: 守护分支：大学保留了古老的看护。

branches.en: The act branch: doing what the guardian does.
branches.cn: 动作分支：做守护者所做的事。

branches.en: The lesson branch: the desk is where both meet.
branches.cn: 功课分支：书桌是双方相遇之处。

branches.en: The study branch: progress is followed week by week.
branches.cn: 学业分支：进度被一周周跟进。

intro.en: Tutor is a Latin agent form, and the family grows with -ial and -ion.
intro.cn: tutor 是拉丁语的施动形式，词族靠 -ial、-ion 扩展。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb tueri, to watch over, supplies the whole family, listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语动词 tueri（看守）供应了整个词族，列在下面。

items.example: He tutored her for a year.

definition_en: coming after the eleventh in order, or one of twelve equal parts
core_image: 楼梯上数到第十二级时抬起的那只脚
scene: 女孩抱着礼物爬楼梯，一级一级数上去，声音停在一个数字上。Her room is on the twelfth floor of the block.
sceneCN: 这里 twelfth 是「第十二」（第 1 个义项：顺序上排在第十一之后的）；句意为她的房间在这栋楼的第十二层。数到第十二级抬脚的那一刻，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由与 twelfth 同源的基数词构成，义为「十二」
由 twelfth 加 -ly 构成，义为「第十二点地」
由 twelfth 加复数词尾构成，义为「若干份十二分之一」

senses.title: The twelfth step
senses.definition: the one that comes after the eleventh
senses.definitionCN: 排在第十一之后的那个
senses.example: Her room is on the twelfth floor of the block.
senses.exampleCN: 她的房间在这栋楼的第十二层。
senses.why: The ending -th turns a count into a position in a queue.
senses.whyCN: 词尾 -th 把计数变成队伍里的位置。

senses.title: One part in twelve
senses.definition: one of twelve equal parts of a whole
senses.definitionCN: 整体等分成十二份后的一份
senses.example: A twelfth of the profit goes to the charity.
senses.exampleCN: 利润的十二分之一捐给慈善机构。
senses.why: A position in a row of twelve can also be read as a share, one step in twelve.
senses.whyCN: 十二个里的一个位置，也可以理解成一份：十二等分中的一格。

senses.title: The twelfth one
senses.definition: the person or thing occupying that place
senses.definitionCN: 占据那个位置的人或物
senses.example: The twelfth to speak was a retired nurse.
senses.exampleCN: 发言的第十二位是一位退休护士。
senses.why: Any place in a line needs a noun for its occupant, so the ordinal stands alone as one.
senses.whyCN: 任何队列里的位置都需要一个名词指称其占位者，于是序数词单独成名词。

intro.en: Twelfth is the ordinal of twelve, reshaped by the old ending of fifth and sixth rather than the regular -th.
intro.cn: twelfth 是 twelve 的序数词，词形受 fifth、sixth 的古老词尾影响而改形，并非规则的 -th 加法。

items.en: Twelf was the base count, and twelfta its ordinal.
items.cn: twelf 是基数，twelfta 是其序数形式。

items.en: The -ta ending marked an ordinal just as -th does today.
items.cn: -ta 词尾的作用与今天的 -th 相同。

items.en: Twelfthe kept the f but lost the second t of the base.
items.cn: twelfthe 保留了 f，却丢掉了基数词里的第二个 t。

items.en: The spelling twelfth restored the f and kept the awkward cluster of consonants.
items.cn: 现代拼写恢复 f，也保留了这个难念的辅音丛。

items.en: Date and floor names made it one of the most spoken ordinals.
items.cn: 日期和楼层使它成为最常被说到的序数词之一。

note.en: The first group holds other ordinals built on the same pattern, the second holds the counting forms.
note.cn: 第一组是同样方式构成的序数词，第二组是计数的基数词。

normalIntro.en: Twelfth looks hard to spell because it keeps both the f and the th of two different endings.
normalIntro.cn: twelfth 难拼，是因为它同时留着两种词尾的 f 和 th。

normal.en: Write twelve, keep the f, drop the ve: twelfth.
normal.cn: 先写 twelve，留 f、去 ve，得 twelfth。

normal.en: Say the f clearly before the th, or drop one in speech.
normal.cn: 两个擦音相连，可放缓，口语也可省一个。

normal.en: Fifth and twelfth are the two irregular f forms.
normal.cn: fifth 与 twelfth 是两个带 f 的不规则形式。

normal.en: Dates use it: the twelfth of June.
normal.cn: 日期用它：the twelfth of June。

normal.en: A twelfth is a piece of a whole cut into twelve.
normal.cn: a twelfth 是把整体切成十二份后的一块。

abstract.en: A foot landing on a step just above the landing.
abstract.cn: 一只脚落在休息平台上方的那一阶。

abstract.en: A clock face with only one mark left of the hour.
abstract.cn: 钟面上离整点只剩一格。

abstract.en: A cake sliced into twelve equal lines.
abstract.cn: 一个被切成十二等份的蛋糕。

examples.en: The lift stopped at the twelfth floor with a jolt.
examples.cn: 电梯猛地一顿，停在了十二楼。

examples.en: She finished twelfth in a field of forty runners.
examples.cn: 她在四十名跑者中跑了第十二名。

examples.en: Only a twelfth of the island is fit for farming.
examples.cn: 这座岛只有十二分之一的土地适合耕种。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「图埃夫斯」——数到十二时要赶紧封口，第十一下之后就是它。

root: 源自中古英语 twelfthe、古英语 twelfta，为 twelve 的序数形式，词形保留了古词尾并回填 f，同族词有 twelve、twelvemonth。

sensesIntro.en: First the place after the eleventh, then a share in twelve, then the person or thing seated there.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是第十一之后的位置，再是十二等分中的一份，最后是占位的那个。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a foot on the twelfth step.
core.cn: 核心意象：落在第十二级台阶上的脚。

branches.en: The order branch: one after the eleventh.
branches.cn: 顺序分支：第十一之后。

branches.en: The fraction branch: one slice of twelve.
branches.cn: 分数分支：十二份中的一片。

branches.en: The occupant branch: a noun made from a place.
branches.cn: 占位分支：位置变成名词。

branches.en: The date branch: order names a day or a floor.
branches.cn: 日期分支：顺序指日期或楼层。

branches.en: The share branch: a slice given to one member.
branches.cn: 份额分支：分给某成员的一块。

intro.en: Twelfth is a root plus an old ordinal ending that has worn down to -th.
intro.cn: twelfth 是词根加古老的序数词尾，词尾已磨损成 -th。

latinIntro.en: The number itself is Germanic, so there is no Latin entry for it below.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词本身属日耳曼语系，因此下面没有拉丁条目。

items.exampleCN: 它构成 fourth 与 tenth。
第十二点，我们必须休息。

items.example: The twelfth of May was rainy.

definition_en: the number that comes after eleven and before thirteen
core_image: 钟面上一圈数字走完，指针回到顶端的十二点
scene: 面包房里，售货员把鸡蛋一格一格码进纸盒。He bought a box of twelve eggs for the cake.
sceneCN: 这里 twelve 是「十二」（第 1 个义项：十一之后、十三之前的数目）；句意为他为做蛋糕买了一盒十二个鸡蛋。钟面走完一圈回到十二点的那格，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 twelve 变来的序数词，义为「第十二」
由 twelve 与 month 合成，义为「一整年」
由 twelve 加复数词尾构成，义为「多组十二」

senses.title: The count of twelve
senses.definition: the number between eleven and thirteen
senses.definitionCN: 介于十一和十三之间的数目
senses.example: He bought a box of twelve eggs for the cake.
senses.exampleCN: 他为做蛋糕买了一盒十二个鸡蛋。
senses.why: The word is one of the oldest counts, taken from a base of ten plus two more.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的计数词之一，构形上就是十再加两个。

senses.title: The group of twelve
senses.definition: a set or group made up of that number
senses.definitionCN: 由这个数目组成的一组
senses.example: The class was split into twelves for the trip.
senses.exampleCN: 旅行时分班时按十二人一组划分。
senses.why: Anything counted can become a unit, so twelve can name a group of twelve.
senses.whyCN: 任何被数的东西都能变成单位，于是 twelve 也能指十二个一组。

senses.title: The clock mark
senses.definition: the hour marked at the top of a clock face
senses.definitionCN: 钟面顶端标示的那个时刻
senses.example: The meeting began at twelve sharp.
senses.exampleCN: 会议在十二点整开始。
senses.why: Because a clock face has twelve marks, the word also names the top of the dial.
senses.whyCN: 钟面有十二个刻度，于是这个词也指表盘最上方那一格。

intro.en: Twelve is a Germanic word built as two left over after ten, a counting method older than written arithmetic.
intro.cn: twelve 是日耳曼语词，构形为「十之后还剩二」，这种数法比成文算术更古老。

items.en: The stem joined two, and the idea of leaving ten behind.
items.cn: 词干把「二」与「十之外多出」的意思拼在一起。

items.en: Twelf was the fixed English form from the earliest records.
items.cn: twelf 从最早的文献起就是固定的英语形式。

items.en: Counting by twelves suited trade, since twelve divides by two, three, four and six.
items.cn: 按十二计数适合交易，因为十二能被二、三、四、六整除。

items.en: Twelve stayed unchanged in form while many nearby numbers shifted.
items.cn: 许多邻近数词发生变形，twelve 却保持不变。

items.en: The clock and the calendar kept the word in daily use.
items.cn: 时钟与日历使这个词天天被用到。

note.en: The first group holds closely related number forms, the second holds other counting words.
note.cn: 第一组是与之紧密相关的数字形式，第二组是其他计数词。

normalIntro.en: Twelve hides two inside itself: two beyond ten.
normalIntro.cn: twelve 里藏着 two：十之外再加两个。

normal.en: The f is silent before v in careless speech, but written f stays.
normal.cn: 口语里 f 很轻，书写不能省。

normal.en: Twelfth is the ordinal, and it never looks like twelve plus th.
normal.cn: 序数是 twelfth，并不像 twelve 直接加 th。

normal.en: Twelve inches make one foot, twelve months make a year.
normal.cn: 十二英寸为一英尺，十二个月为一年。

normal.en: O'clock twelve is the top of the dial.
normal.cn: 十二点正是表盘顶端。

normal.en: A dozen is simply another name for twelve.
normal.cn: a dozen 就是十二的另一个说法。

abstract.en: A clock hand pointing straight up.
abstract.cn: 指针笔直朝上的钟。

abstract.en: An egg box full of equal hollows.
abstract.cn: 装满等大的一个个凹槽的蛋盒。

abstract.en: Twelve tally marks in a neat row.
abstract.cn: 一排整齐的十二道刻痕。

examples.en: The trip takes twelve hours by train.
examples.cn: 坐火车这趟旅行要十二个小时。

intro.en: Twelve is a compound numeral from Germanic roots, with few affixes of its own.

definition_en: coming after the nineteenth in order, or one of twenty equal parts
core_image: 一长列台阶走到底，第二十级上插着一面粉色小旗
scene: 跑者数着路边的里程牌，最后一块写着终点。This is the twentieth year the race has been held.
sceneCN: 这里 twentieth 是「第二十」（第 1 个义项：顺序上排在第十九之后的）；句意为这场比赛已经举办了第二十个年头。第二十级台阶上插着小旗的画面，就是这个词的样子。

derivatives.zh: 与 twentieth 同源的基数词，义为「二十」
同义的成组计数词，义为「二十个」
由 twentieth 加 -ly 构成，义为「第二十点地」

senses.title: The twentieth step
senses.definition: the one that comes after the nineteenth
senses.definitionCN: 排在第十九之后的那个
senses.example: This is the twentieth year the race has been held.
senses.exampleCN: 这场比赛已经举办了第二十个年头。
senses.why: Twenty plus the ordinal ending gives a place at the end of the second set of ten.
senses.whyCN: 二十加序数词尾，得到第二组十个的末尾位置。

senses.title: One part in twenty
senses.definition: one of twenty equal parts of a whole
senses.definitionCN: 整体等分成二十份后的一份
senses.example: A twentieth of the budget goes on postage.
senses.exampleCN: 预算的二十分之一花在邮费上。
senses.why: A place among twenty can be read as a share, one step of twenty.
senses.whyCN: 二十个中的一格同样可以看作份额，二十步中的一步。

senses.title: The twentieth one
senses.definition: the person or thing in that position
senses.definitionCN: 占据那个位置的人或物
senses.example: The twentieth in the queue was turned away.
senses.exampleCN: 排在第二十位的人被劝了回去。
senses.why: Order needs a stand-in noun when the position itself is the subject.
senses.whyCN: 当位置本身作主语时，序数词需要一个代替名词的身份。

intro.en: Twentieth is twenty plus the old ordinal ending -th, with the y of twenty softened to ie.
intro.cn: twentieth 是 twenty 加古老序数词尾 -th，twenty 的 y 变作 ie。

items.en: Twentig was the count of twenty, and twentigotha its ordinal.
items.cn: twentig 是二十，twentigotha 是其序数形式。

items.en: The stem itself grew from a Germanic word for a group of ten.
items.cn: 这个词干来自日耳曼语中表示一组十个的词。

items.en: Twentithe settled the shape of the modern word.
items.cn: twentithe 确立了现代词形。

items.en: The century phrase maked it one of the most used ordinals.
items.cn: 「二十世纪」这一说法使它成为最常用的序数词之一。

items.en: The fraction use grew alongside the ordinal use.
items.cn: 分数用法与序数用法一同发展起来。

note.en: The first group holds forms built on twenty, the second holds other ordinals and counts.
note.cn: 第一组是建立在 twenty 上的形式，第二组是其他序数词与计数词。

normalIntro.en: Twentieth is twenty with its y turned to ie and an old th added.
normalIntro.cn: twentieth 就是 twenty 的 y 变 ie 再加 th。

normal.en: Twenty becomes twentie before the ending, as in the spelling.
normal.cn: 加词尾时 twenty 变作 twentie。

normal.en: Two syllables: TWEN-ti-eth, with a light last beat.
normal.cn: 三个音节，最后一个很轻。

normal.en: Centuries are numbered this way: the twentieth century.
normal.cn: 世纪就是这样编号：the twentieth century。

normal.en: A score is an old word for exactly twenty.
normal.cn: score 是「二十个」的古老说法。

normal.en: Dates use it: the twentieth of March.
normal.cn: 日期用它：the twentieth of March。

abstract.en: A small flag pinned on the last of a long flight of steps.
abstract.cn: 插在一长列台阶尽头的小旗。

abstract.en: A calendar page turning to a round number.
abstract.cn: 翻到一个整数的那页日历。

abstract.en: Twenty tallies crossed out one by one.
abstract.cn: 一道道被划掉的二十个记号。

examples.en: The bridge was built in the early twentieth century.
examples.cn: 这座桥建于二十世纪初。

examples.en: She came twentieth out of two hundred entrants.
examples.cn: 她在两百名参赛者中排第二十。

examples.en: A twentieth of the land is still forest.
examples.cn: 这片土地仍有二十分之一是森林。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吞替厄斯」——两个十叠在一起，站在第二十格才算数。

root: 源自中古英语 twentithe、古英语 twentigotha，为 twenty 的序数形式，词干上溯日耳曼语中表示「十个一组」的词，同族词有 twenty。

sensesIntro.en: First the position after the nineteenth, then a share in twenty, then the one who holds that place.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是第十九之后的位置，再是二十等分里的一份，最后是占位者。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a flag on the twentieth step.
core.cn: 核心意象：第二十级台阶上的小旗。

branches.en: The order branch: the end of the second ten.
branches.cn: 顺序分支：第二组十个的末尾。

branches.en: The fraction branch: one step of twenty.
branches.cn: 分数分支：二十步中的一步。

branches.en: The occupant branch: the noun made from a place.
branches.cn: 占位分支：位置变出的名词。

branches.en: The century branch: counted time becomes a name.
branches.cn: 世纪分支：计数的时间变成名称。

branches.en: The birthday branch: a life counted in twenties.
branches.cn: 生日分支：生命被二十整除的一次。

intro.en: Twentieth is twenty plus the worn ordinal ending -th, and stands mostly alone as a word family.
intro.cn: twentieth 是 twenty 加磨损的序数词尾 -th，词族很小。

latinIntro.en: The count is Germanic, so no Latin source word applies below.
latinIntro.cn: 这个数词属日耳曼语，下面没有拉丁来源词。

items.meaning: the years from twenty to twenty-nine

definition_en: the number that comes after nineteen and before twenty-one
core_image: 摊开的双手加上十个脚趾之外，又数出十个同样的物件
scene: 集市收摊前，摊主把剩下的杯子摞起来清点。Twenty cups were left on the table when the market closed.
sceneCN: 这里 twenty 是「二十」（第 1 个义项：十九之后、二十一之前的数目）；句意为收摊时桌上还剩二十个杯子。摊主清点剩下物件的那一刻，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 twenty 变来的序数词，义为「第二十」
由 twenty 加复数词尾构成，义为「二十多岁；二十年代」
复数另义，义为「面额二十的钞票」

senses.title: The count of twenty
senses.definition: the number between nineteen and twenty-one
senses.definitionCN: 介于十九和二十一之间的数目
senses.example: Twenty cups were left on the table when the market closed.
senses.exampleCN: 收摊时桌上还剩二十个杯子。
senses.why: The word is built from the old Germanic two and a suffix meaning a group of ten.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由古日耳曼语的「二」和一个表示「十个一组」的词尾构成。

senses.title: The group of twenty
senses.definition: a set made up of that number
senses.definitionCN: 由这个数目组成的一组
senses.example: The volunteers went out in twenties to clear the beach.
senses.exampleCN: 志愿者按二十人一组去清理海滩。
senses.why: A number used as a unit of grouping stops counting and starts naming a set.
senses.whyCN: 被当作分组单位的数词不再单纯计数，而开始命名一个集合。

senses.title: The age and the decade
senses.definition: the years of life or history between twenty and twenty-nine
senses.definitionCN: 人生或历史中二十至二十九的那一段
senses.example: She wrote her first novel in her twenties.
senses.exampleCN: 她在二十多岁时写出第一部小说。
senses.why: Because the teens end at nineteen, the next ten years take their name from the round number twenty.
senses.whyCN: 因为十几岁止于十九，接下来的十年便取了整数二十作名。

intro.en: Twenty is a Germanic compound whose second element once meant a group of ten.
intro.cn: twenty 是日耳曼语合成词，后半部分原指「十个一组」。

items.en: The compound joined two with a word for a ten-count.
items.cn: 这个合成词把「二」和表示「十个之数」的词接在一起。

items.en: Twentig is recorded from the earliest English.
items.cn: twentig 在最早的英语文献中已有记录。

items.en: Counting by tens up to a hundred used the same element throughout.
items.cn: 十进计数一路用到百，都用同一个成分。

items.en: Twenti lost the final g and settled into its modern sound.
items.cn: twenti 丢了末尾的 g，定下现代读音。

items.en: Twentieth and the twenties noun completed the family.
items.cn: twentieth 与 twenties 补全了整个词族。

note.en: The first group holds forms made from twenty, the second holds neighbouring counts.
note.cn: 第一组是 twenty 变出的形式，第二组是邻近的计数词。

normalIntro.en: Twenty is two tens held together in one word.
normalIntro.cn: twenty 就是两个十被同一个词装着。

normal.en: The first syllable rhymes with when, the second with tea.
normal.cn: 前一首节近于 when，后一音节近于 tea。

normal.en: Drop the y and add ies for the plural noun.

normal.en: Twentieth is the ordinal, with y turned to ie.
normal.cn: 序数词是 twentieth，y 变 ie。

normal.en: In one's twenties means the age after nineteen.

normal.en: A score is an older word for the same twenty.

abstract.en: A calendar page showing a round number.
abstract.cn: 日历上翻到的一个整数。

examples.cn: 有二十人报名了晚班。

examples.en: He counted his change twice to make sure it was twenty.
examples.cn: 他把零钱数了两遍，确认是二十。

examples.cn: 这家店在午夜前二十分钟关门。

root: 源自中古英语 twenti、古英语 twentig，为日耳曼语「二」与「十数」的合成词，同族词有 twentieth、twenties。

sensesIntro.en: First the number, then a group of that size, then the decade of life or history that carries its name.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是数目，再是这么大小的组，最后是冠以这个数的十年。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a round count on a table.
core.cn: 核心意象：桌面上一个整齐的数目。

branches.en: The number branch: exactly two tens.
branches.cn: 数目分支：正好两个十。

branches.en: The group branch: twenty as one unit.
branches.cn: 组合分支：二十作一个单位。

branches.en: The age branch: the ten years after nineteen.
branches.cn: 年龄分支：十九之后的十年。

branches.en: The history branch: a decade wears the number.
branches.cn: 历史分支：一个年代冠上这个数。

intro.en: Twenty is an old compound with a suffix that once meant a group of ten.

definition_en: two times, or two times as much
core_image: 同一扇门上敲了两下，间隔很短
scene: 门口没人应答，访客抬起手又敲了一次。She knocked twice and then waited on the step.
sceneCN: 这里 twice 是「两次」（第 1 个义项：同一动作做了两回）；句意为她敲了两下门，然后在台阶上等着。抬手敲第二下的那一瞬，就是这个词的样子。

derivatives.zh: 由 twice 与 yearly 合成，义为「每年两次的」
与 twice 同源的基数词，义为「二」
由 twice 与 told 合成，义为「讲过两遍的；老套的」

senses.title: Two knocks
senses.definition: on two occasions, counted
senses.definitionCN: 在两次场合，按次数计
senses.example: She knocked twice and then waited on the step.
senses.exampleCN: 她敲了两下门，然后在台阶上等着。
senses.why: The word counts occurrences rather than measuring anything.
senses.whyCN: 这个词数的是发生的次数，而不是度量多少。

senses.title: Twice as much
senses.definition: by a factor of two when comparing amounts
senses.definitionCN: 比较数量时达到两倍的倍数
senses.example: Their new flat is twice the size of the old one.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的新公寓是旧公寓的两倍大。
senses.why: Two occasions become two shares, so the counting word stretches into a multiplier.
senses.whyCN: 两次变成两份，计数词于是伸长为倍数词。

intro.en: Twice is an old English adverb built on two, with the same ending once carries for one.
intro.cn: twice 是古英语副词，由 two 构成，词尾与 once 之于 one 相同。

items.en: Twiga or twiges marked the second time, parallel to the form for once.
items.cn: twiga 或 twiges 表示第二次，与表示一次的写法并行。

items.en: The form settled as twies, with an adverbial s at the end.
items.cn: 词形定为 twies，末尾带副词性的 s。

items.en: Once and twice worked as a matched pair of frequency words.
items.cn: once 与 twice 成为一对匹配的频度词。

items.en: The spelling moved to c while the sound stayed the same.
items.cn: 拼写改为 c，读音未变。

items.en: Comparisons of amount widened twice into a multiplier.
items.cn: 数量比较使 twice 扩展为倍数。

note.en: The first group holds words of the same frequency family, the second holds amount words.
note.cn: 第一组是同一频度家族的词，第二组是数量词。

normalIntro.en: Twice and once are a matched pair: one time, two times.
normalIntro.cn: twice 与 once 是一对：一次，两次。

normal.en: Once and twice are single words; three times needs two words.
normal.cn: 一次、两次各是一个词，三次要说两个词。

normal.en: Twice a week answers how often, not how many.
normal.cn: twice a week 回答的是频率而非数量。

normal.en: Twice as much is followed by a comparison.
normal.cn: twice as much 后面常接比较。

normal.en: Think twice means pause before acting.
normal.cn: think twice 意为行动前先想一想。

normal.en: The c is pronounced like the s in same.
normal.cn: 这里的 c 读如 s。

abstract.en: Two rings left in the air by a raised hand.
abstract.cn: 一只手抬起留下的两下敲门声。

abstract.en: A set of scales tipped well past the middle.
abstract.cn: 一架严重偏向一侧的天平。

abstract.en: A ruler folded once, then laid against another.
abstract.cn: 把尺子折一次再与另一把比量。

examples.en: He takes the medicine twice a day.
examples.cn: 他每天吃两次药。

examples.en: I have read the letter twice.
examples.cn: 这封信我读了两遍。

examples.en: The new hall is twice as wide as the old one.
examples.cn: 新礼堂的宽度是旧礼堂的两倍。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「特外斯」——外面敲了一下，特地在里面又敲一下，共两次。

sensesIntro.en: First a count of occasions, then the count turned into a multiplier.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是次数，再由次数转为倍数。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two knocks in quick succession.
core.cn: 核心意象：紧挨着的两下敲门声。

branches.en: The occasion branch: two events, nothing more.
branches.cn: 场合分支：两个事件而已。

branches.en: The multiplier branch: two shares at once.
branches.cn: 倍数分支：一次两份。

branches.en: The habit branch: twice a day becomes routine.
branches.cn: 习惯分支：每天两次成为常规。

branches.en: The comparison branch: a double measure.
branches.cn: 比较分支：双倍的量度。

branches.en: The price branch: paying twice over.
branches.cn: 代价分支：付出两遍。

intro.en: Twice is a root plus an old adverbial ending, sitting beside once and thrice.
intro.cn: twice 是词根加古老副词词尾，与 once、thrice 并列。

latinIntro.en: The frequency ending is Germanic, and the Latin equivalents of bis and duo are listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 频度词尾属日耳曼语，下面列出拉丁语的 bis 与 duo。
