definition_zh: 双胞胎之一；成对的；使成对
definition_en: one of two children born at the same time, or either of a matching pair
core_image: 两张一模一样的脸并排睡着，呼吸几乎同步
scene: 婴儿床里并排放着两个小篮子，两顶同样的小帽子挨在一起。Her twin brother lives in the next street.
sceneCN: 这里 twin 是「双胞胎之一」（第 1 个义项：同时出生的两个孩子中的一个）；句意为她的双胞胎哥哥住在隔壁那条街。两张一模一样的脸，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 twin 加 -ing 构成，义为「结为姊妹城市；成对」
由 twin 加 -ed 构成，义为「结成姊妹的；成对的」
由 twin 加指小词尾构成，义为「双生的小东西」

senses.title: The matching child
senses.definition: one of two children born to the same mother at the same time
senses.definitionCN: 同一位母亲在同一次生产中产下的两个孩子之一
senses.example: Her twin brother lives in the next street.
senses.exampleCN: 她的双胞胎哥哥住在隔壁那条街。
senses.why: The word names one half of a pair that nature made at the same moment.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名一对同时被自然造出的孩子中的一半。

senses.title: The matching pair
senses.definition: used before a noun for one of two things that are alike or joined
senses.definitionCN: 用在名词前，指两件相似或相连的事物之一
senses.example: The twin towers stood at the harbour mouth.
senses.exampleCN: 双塔立于港口入口。
senses.why: Anything that comes in a matching pair can carry the word as a label.
senses.whyCN: 凡成双成对的东西都能用这个词作标签。

senses.title: The linking act
senses.definition: to join two things closely, as towns or schools are paired
senses.definitionCN: 把两者紧密联结，如城市或学校结为姊妹单位
senses.example: The town is twinned with a village in Italy.
senses.exampleCN: 这个镇与意大利的一个村庄结为姊妹城镇。
senses.why: If nature can produce a pair, people can also decide to make one, so the verb means to pair.
senses.whyCN: 自然能生出成对之物，人也能决定造出一对，于是动词表「配成对」。

intro.en: Twin is a Germanic word meaning two together, closely related to the words for two and twilight.
intro.cn: twin 是日耳曼语中「两个一起」的词，与 two、twilight 关系密切。

items.en: The root meant a pair or a double thing born together.
items.cn: 这个词根意为成对或同时出生的两件物。

items.en: Twinn meant double, and getwinn meant a pair of twins.
items.cn: twinn 意为双的，getwinn 意为双生的一对。

items.en: Twin came to name one child of such a pair.
items.cn: twin 转而指这样一对中的一个孩子。

items.en: Shapes, rooms and towers borrowed the word for anything matching.
items.cn: 形状、房间、高塔都借这个词表示成对。

items.en: The verb appeared with town twinning after the war.
items.cn: 战后同城结对使人看到它的动词用法。

note.en: The first group shares the two-ness of the stem, the second names pairs and doubles.
note.cn: 第一组共享词干里的「二」，第二组是成双、成对的词。

normalIntro.en: Twin has two in it, both in sound and in sense.
normalIntro.cn: twin 的声音和意思里都装着「二」。

normal.en: Twin, twist, twine and twilight all share the tw- beginning of twoness.
normal.cn: twin、twist、twine、twilight 都带着表示成双的 tw-。

normal.en: Identical twins come from one egg, fraternal twins from two.
normal.cn: 同卵双胞胎来自一个卵，异卵来自两个。

normal.en: As an adjective it never takes a plural: twin sisters.
normal.cn: 作形容词时不用复数：twin sisters。

normal.en: To twin towns is to sign a bond between them.
normal.cn: 两个城市 twin 起来就是签下联系。

normal.en: A twin room holds two single beds.
normal.cn: twin room 就是两张单人床的房间。

abstract.en: Two identical caps side by side in one pram.
abstract.cn: 一辆婴儿车里并排的两顶小帽。

abstract.en: Two towers reflected in still water.
abstract.cn: 静水里的双塔倒影。

abstract.en: Two names written on one shared door.
abstract.cn: 一扇共用的门上写着的两个名字。

examples.en: The twins wore the same red coat.
examples.cn: 这对双胞胎穿着同样的红外套。

examples.en: Look for the twin chimneys on the roof.
examples.cn: 找屋顶上那对一模一样的烟囱。

examples.en: The city twinned with a port in Japan last spring.
examples.cn: 这座城市去年春天与日本的一个港口城市结为姊妹城市。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吞因」——一个因由吞出两个一模一样的人，就是双胞胎。

root: 源自中古英语 twin、古英语 twinn（双的），与 two、twilight 同出日耳曼语表示「成双」的词根，同族词有 twinning、twinned。

sensesIntro.en: First one child of a born pair, then the adjective for matching things, then the act of pairing them.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是出生一对中的一个，再是修饰成对之物的形容词，最后是配成对的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two faces asleep in step.
core.cn: 核心意象：两张同步睡去的脸。

branches.en: The person branch: one half of a natural pair.
branches.cn: 人分支：天生一对中的一半。

branches.en: The label branch: anything matching a partner.
branches.cn: 标签分支：与同伴相配的任何东西。

branches.en: The bond branch: people pair what nature did not.
branches.cn: 联结分支：人把自然未配的配成对。

branches.en: The building branch: towers built as a pair.
branches.cn: 建筑分支：成对建起的塔。

branches.en: The town branch: two towns signed as one pair.
branches.cn: 城市分支：两个城市签成一对。

intro.en: Twin is a short Germanic root that doubles as noun, adjective and verb.
intro.cn: twin 是简短的日耳曼词根，兼作名词、形容词与动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin geminus carries the same twin idea and gave English several words, listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 geminus 带同样的双生观念，为英语贡献了若干词，列在下面。

items.exampleCN: 我的双胞胎兄长大一些。
姊妹城市结对从这里开始。

items.example: A rare word for a small twin.

items.exampleCN: 它开头的 twist 与 two 都有此意。

definition_en: to turn something round with force, or to bend and change its shape or meaning
core_image: 双手捏住湿毛巾两端，向相反方向用力拧出水来
scene: 厨房水槽边，洗完的抹布还滴着水，有人双手一拧。He twisted the cloth until the last drops fell into the sink.
sceneCN: 这里 twist 是「拧；扭」（第 1 个义项：用两手向相反方向转动）；句意为他一直拧抹布，直到最后几滴水落进水槽。双手反方向拧毛巾的动作，就是这个词的样子。

derivatives.zh: 由 twist 加 -er 构成，义为「龙卷风；扭曲者」
由 twist 加 -ed 构成，义为「扭曲的」
由 twist 加 -y 构成，义为「弯弯曲曲的」

senses.title: The wringing hands
senses.definition: to turn something firmly in opposite directions
senses.definitionCN: 把某物两端向相反方向用力转动
senses.example: He twisted the cloth until the last drops fell into the sink.
senses.exampleCN: 他一直拧抹布，直到最后几滴水落进水槽。
senses.why: The core is force applied in opposite directions to the two ends of a thing.
senses.whyCN: 核心是对物体的两端反向施力。

senses.title: The wrenched joint
senses.definition: to hurt a joint by turning it too far
senses.definitionCN: 因转动过度而损伤关节
senses.example: She twisted her knee on the uneven path.
senses.exampleCN: 她在凹凸不平的小路上扭伤了膝盖。
senses.why: A joint is hurt when it is turned further than its own hinge allows.
senses.whyCN: 关节之所以受伤，是因为被转过了它自身的铰链所允许的限度。

senses.title: The turn in the story
senses.definition: an unexpected change in events or meaning
senses.definitionCN: 事件或含义中出人意料的变化
senses.example: The story takes a strange twist at the end.
senses.exampleCN: 故事在结尾处出现一个奇怪的转折。
senses.why: A plot that changes direction is doing the same thing a rope does.
senses.whyCN: 情节改变方向，做的正是绳子做的那件事。

senses.title: The bent truth
senses.definition: to give words or facts a meaning they do not have
senses.definitionCN: 把话语或事实解释成原本没有的意思
senses.example: The report twisted what she had said.
senses.exampleCN: 那篇报道歪曲了她说过的话。
senses.why: Once twisting moves from cloth to words, it means bending a meaning out of shape.
senses.whyCN: 当「拧」从布转到话语上，它便意味着把原意拧离本形。

intro.en: Twist is a Germanic word for a divided thing, from the same family as two and twin.
intro.cn: twist 是日耳曼语中表示「分成两股」的词，与 two、twin 同族。

items.en: The root meant a fork or a thing split into two strands.
items.cn: 这个词根意为叉或分成两股之物。

items.en: Twist named a doubled thread, two strands wound together.
items.cn: twist 指双股线，两股缠在一起。

items.en: The noun spread from thread to anything turned with force.
items.cn: 名词从线扩展到一切被用力转动的东西。

items.en: The verb took over the action: to twist a rope, a cap, an ankle.
items.cn: 动词接管了动作：拧绳、拧盖、扭伤脚踝。

items.en: Turning words became turning truth, giving the sense of distortion.
items.cn: 转动话语变成转动事实，生出「歪曲」义。

note.en: The first group shares the tw- stem, the second holds other turning verbs.
note.cn: 第一组共享 tw- 词干，第二组是其他表示转动的动词。

entries.definition: A whirlwind or a distorting person.
The joint between hand and arm.
To pull out of true shape.

normalIntro.en: Twist begins like two because it is about two strands turning round each other.
normalIntro.cn: twist 开头像 two，因为它讲的是两股互相绕转。

normal.en: Twist, twin, twine and two all open with tw-.
normal.cn: twist、twin、twine、two 都以 tw- 开头。

normal.en: A twist in the plot is the same turning, done to events.
normal.cn: 情节转折是把同一个「转」施加到事件上。

normal.en: The -ed form doubles as an adjective: twisted metal.
normal.cn: 过去分词兼作形容词：扭曲的金属。

normal.en: Twist off, twist open, twist the cap.
normal.cn: 常用搭配：twist off、twist open、twist the cap。

normal.en: A twisty road turns again and again.
normal.cn: twisty 的路一转再转。

abstract.en: Water falling from a wrung cloth.
abstract.cn: 从拧干的布里落下的水。

abstract.en: A rope whose two strands spiral round each other.
abstract.cn: 两股互相盘旋的绳子。

abstract.en: A road doubling back behind a hill.
abstract.cn: 在山后折返的路。

examples.en: Twist the cap until you hear a click.
examples.cn: 拧瓶盖，直到听见一声咔哒。

examples.en: He twisted his back lifting the crate.
examples.cn: 他抬箱子时扭伤了背。

examples.en: The plot has a twist that nobody expected.
examples.cn: 情节有一个谁都没想到的转折。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「特维斯」——特地用力往反方向一拧，布就扭成螺旋。

root: 源自中古英语 twist（双股线）、古英语 twist，与 two、twine、twin 同出日耳曼语表示「分股、成双」的词根，同族词有 twister、twisted、twisty。

sensesIntro.en: First the hands turning a cloth, then a harmed joint, then a turn in events, and finally a turn given to the truth.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是双手拧布，再是受伤的关节，再是事件的转折，最后是给事实拧出来的弯。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands wringing a cloth.
core.cn: 核心意象：两手拧一条布。

branches.en: The material branch: force on both ends.
branches.cn: 材料分支：两端受相反的力。

branches.en: The body branch: a joint turned too far.
branches.cn: 身体分支：关节被转过量。

branches.en: The narrative branch: events take a bend.
branches.cn: 叙事分支：事件拐了个弯。

branches.en: The language branch: words are bent to fit.
branches.cn: 语言分支：话语被拧着凑合。

branches.en: The shape branch: spirals in rope and in story.
branches.cn: 形状分支：绳与故事里的螺旋。

intro.en: Twist is a free root with a tw- beginning that marks doubled things, and the family grows with -er and -ed.
intro.cn: twist 是自由词根，开头的 tw- 标记成双之物，词族靠 -er、-ed 扩展。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic, so the Latin list below gives related twisting words.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根属日耳曼语，下面列出相关的拉丁「扭」词。

definition_en: the number that comes after one and before three
core_image: 两只一模一样的杯子并排立在窗台
scene: 清晨的巴士站，等车的人不多，只有两个。Two passengers stood at the bus stop in the rain.
sceneCN: 这里 two 是「二」（第 1 个义项：一之后、三之前的数目）；句意为雨中有两名乘客站在巴士站。两只杯子并排的画面，就是这个词的样子。

derivatives.zh: 与 two 同义的序数词，义为「第二」
由与 two 同源的词干构成，义为「两次；两倍」
由与 two 同源的词根构成，义为「双胞胎之一」
由 two 加复数词尾构成，义为「若干个二」

senses.title: The count of two
senses.definition: the number between one and three
senses.definitionCN: 介于一的与三之间的数目
senses.example: Two passengers stood at the bus stop in the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 雨中有两名乘客站在巴士站。
senses.why: The word is one of the oldest Germanic numbers and has changed very little.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是最古老的日耳曼数词之一，几乎没变过形。

senses.title: The pair
senses.definition: a group made up of that number, often a natural pair
senses.definitionCN: 由这个数组成的一组，常指天生的一对
senses.example: The shoes cost less if you take the two together.
senses.exampleCN: 两件一起买更便宜。
senses.why: A count used of natural pairs turns into the name of the pair itself.
senses.whyCN: 用来数天生成对之物的数词，转指这一对本身。

senses.title: The split in half
senses.definition: a division of one thing into that number of parts
senses.definitionCN: 把一样东西分成这个数目的份
senses.example: She cut the cake in two and gave him the larger half.
senses.exampleCN: 她把蛋糕切成两半，把大的那半给了他。
senses.why: To cut in two is to use the number as a way of dividing rather than counting.
senses.whyCN: 切成两半是用这个数划分事物，而非清点事物。

intro.en: Two belongs to the oldest layer of English and has close relatives in nearly every related language.
intro.cn: two 属于英语最古老的一层，几乎在所有亲属语言里都有对应的词。

items.en: The root twai named a pair in the earliest Germanic speech.
items.cn: 词根 twai 在最早的日耳曼语中命名成对之物。

items.en: Twa was used for men, and a neuter form for other things.
items.cn: twa 用于人，另有一个中性形式用于其他事物。

items.en: Two replaced the older forms and lost its final syllable.
items.cn: two 取代了旧形式，也丢掉了末音节。

items.en: The w is silent, but it shows up again in twice and twin.
items.cn: w 不发音，却在 twice 与 twin 里重新现形。

items.en: The word sits inside dozens of compounds, from twofold to twenty.
items.cn: 从 twofold 到 twenty，数十个合成词里都有它。

note.en: The first group holds words built on the same root, the second holds neighbouring numbers.
note.cn: 第一组是同根词，第二组是邻近的数词。

entries.definition: One of a pair of children.
One of the digits of a foot.

normalIntro.en: Two hides a w that never sounds but always returns in its relatives.
normalIntro.cn: two 藏着一个从不发音的 w，却在亲属词里常常回来。

normal.en: The w of two is silent, but spoken in twin and twice.
normal.cn: two 的 w 不发音，但在 twin、twice 里回来。

normal.en: In two means cut into halves.
normal.cn: in two 表示切成两半。

normal.en: Two by two means in pairs.
normal.cn: two by two 表示两个两个地。

normal.en: The ordinal of two is second, but second is shared with second in time.
normal.cn: two 的序数是 second，与「秒」同形。

normal.en: The tw- beginning marks hundreds of English words about pairing.
normal.cn: tw- 开头标记了成百个关于成对的英语词。

abstract.en: Two identical cups on a windowsill.
abstract.cn: 窗台上两只一模一样的杯子。

abstract.en: A line dividing a page into equal halves.
abstract.cn: 把一页纸对分的线。

abstract.en: Footprints, always in pairs.
abstract.cn: 总是成双的脚印。

examples.en: There are two ways to reach the station.
examples.cn: 去车站有两条路。

examples.en: The two of us walked home together.
examples.cn: 我们两个一起走回家。

examples.en: Cut the bread in two and share it.
examples.cn: 把面包切成两半，分着吃。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「兔」——兔子有两只长耳朵，正好两个。

root: 源自中古英语 two、古英语 twa/twa，属日耳曼语最古老的数词层，同族词有 twice、twin、twist、twenty。

sensesIntro.en: First the number, then a natural pair, then the act of splitting something into halves.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是数目，再是天生的一对，最后是把它当作划分的一半。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two equal cups side by side.
core.cn: 核心意象：并排的两只同样的杯子。

branches.en: The number branch: one step past one.
branches.cn: 数目分支：比一多一步。

branches.en: The pair branch: what goes together.
branches.cn: 成对分支：总在一起的两者。

branches.en: The half branch: one whole cut in two.
branches.cn: 一半分支：整体被分成两份。

branches.en: The counting branch: hundreds grow from twos.
branches.cn: 计数分支：成百由一个个二组成。

branches.en: The choice branch: only two sides exist.
branches.cn: 选择分支：只有两边可站。

intro.en: Two is a bare Germanic numeral, so its structure lies in the compounds it joins.
intro.cn: two 是光秃秃的日耳曼数词，它的结构藏在所入合成词里。

latinIntro.en: Latin duo gave English the duo- family, listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 duo 为英语带来 duo- 词族，列在下面。

items.exampleCN: 它开头的 duo 与 duplex 都含二。
它开头的 twist 与 twenty 都含此意。

definition_en: a class of things sharing features, or to write on a keyboard
core_image: 一排金属字模从盒子里被拣出来，按在纸上留下同一形状的印记
scene: 灯光下，一个人把要交的报告一行行敲进电脑。She typed the last line and saved the file.
sceneCN: 这里 type 是「打字；键入」（第 3 个义项：通过键盘逐个输入字符）；句意为她打完最后一行并保存了文件。指尖在键盘上逐个落下的动作，就是这个词的样子。

derivatives.zh: 由 type 加 -ical 构成，义为「典型的」
由 type 加 -ing 构成，义为「打字」
由 type 与 writer 合成，义为「打字机」
由 type 加 -ist 构成，义为「打字员」

senses.title: The family likeness
senses.definition: a group of things that share the same features
senses.definitionCN: 具有相同特征的一类事物
senses.example: This type of engine is common in small boats.
senses.exampleCN: 这种发动机在小船上很常见。
senses.why: The noun first named the shared form, the stamp that made many copies alike.
senses.whyCN: 名词起初指共有的形状，即许多复制品共用的那个印模。

senses.title: The metal letter
senses.definition: a small block of metal with a raised letter used for printing
senses.definitionCN: 印有凸起字母的金属小块，用于印刷
senses.example: The printer sorted the worn type back into its box.
senses.exampleCN: 印刷工把磨旧的活字重新装回字盒。
senses.why: A type was the physical thing that pressed a shape onto paper, the same word for the class and the stamp.
senses.whyCN: 活字正是把形状压到纸上的实物，同一个词兼指类别与印模。

senses.title: The tapping keys
senses.definition: to write by pressing keys on a machine or keyboard
senses.definitionCN: 通过按键在机器或键盘上书写
senses.example: She typed the last line and saved the file.
senses.exampleCN: 她打完最后一行并保存了文件。
senses.why: Since the letters came from type, the act of setting them became typing.
senses.whyCN: 因为字母来自活字，排印它们的动作便成了 typing。

intro.en: Type comes from Greek typos, a blow or the mark a blow leaves, through Latin and French.
intro.cn: type 来自希腊语 typos（一击、一击留下的印），经拉丁语与法语传下。

items.en: Typos meant a blow, and then the mark stamped by a blow.
items.cn: typos 意为击打，进而指击打留下的印痕。

items.en: Typus borrowed the idea of a figure or an image.
items.cn: typus 借来了图案、形象的意思。

items.en: French type narrowed it to a symbol or a model.
items.cn: 法语 type 把它收窄为符号或模型。

items.en: Printing gave it a body: movable type, a block that stamps letters.
items.cn: 印刷使它有了实体：活字，即压出字母的块。

items.en: From printing the word spread to kinds of things and to typing on keys.
items.cn: 从印刷扩展到事物的种类，再扩展到敲键盘。

note.en: The first group shares the Greek stem, the second names classes and keyboard work.
note.cn: 第一组共享希腊词干，第二组是类别与键盘操作相关词。

entries.definition: A group in a system of classes.
The set of keys used to type.

normalIntro.en: Type began as a blow and ended as a keyboard: the mark and the making of marks.
normalIntro.cn: type 从一击开始，落到了键盘上：印痕与制造印痕。

normal.en: Type goes with typical, which means showing the type.
normal.cn: type 与 typical 同源，后者意为体现这一类的样子。

normal.en: Type of takes a singular type even before a plural noun.
normal.cn: type of 后用单数 type。

normal.en: Type in means to enter text on a screen.
normal.cn: type in 表示在屏幕上录入。

normal.en: Blood type shows how the word names a class.
normal.cn: blood type 显示它如何命名类别。

normal.en: Typing is not writing by hand, but both leave marks.
normal.cn: 打字不是手写，但都在留下痕迹。

abstract.en: A row of metal letters in a wooden tray.
abstract.cn: 木盘里一排金属字母。

abstract.en: A finger coming down on one key.
abstract.cn: 一根手指落在某个键上。

abstract.en: One shape stamped many times on one page.
abstract.cn: 同一个形状在纸页上被压了许多次。

examples.en: I typed my address into the form.
examples.cn: 我把地址输入了表格。

examples.en: That type of plant needs little water.
examples.cn: 那种植物几乎不需要水。

examples.en: She can type faster than she can write by hand.
examples.cn: 她打字比手写还快。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太普」——太普通的一类，大家都属于同一种类型。

root: 源自晚期拉丁语 typus、希腊语 typos（一击、印痕），本义为压出的印记，进而指类别的模型，同族词有 typical、typewriter、typist、typo。

sensesIntro.en: First the class of things, then the metal block that prints them, then the act of pressing keys.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是事物的类别，再是印出字母的金属块，最后是敲键的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a metal letter pressed on a page.
core.cn: 核心意象：压在纸上的金属活字。

branches.en: The class branch: many things share one stamp.
branches.cn: 类别分支：许多事物共一个印模。

branches.en: The print branch: the block behind the letter.
branches.cn: 印刷分支：字母背后的那块金属。

branches.en: The key branch: the stamping done by fingers.
branches.cn: 按键分支：用手指完成的压印。

branches.en: The trade branch: printers sort their types.
branches.cn: 行业分支：印刷工整理活字。

branches.en: The machine branch: stamps become keys.
branches.cn: 机器分支：印模变成按键。

intro.en: Type is a Greek root, and the family grows with -ical, -ist, -ing and compounds.
intro.cn: type 是希腊词根，词族靠 -ical、-ist、-ing 及合成扩展。

latinIntro.en: The Latin form typus supplied the whole family, listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁形式 typus 供应了整个词族，列在下面。

definition_en: a machine with keys that prints letters on paper by striking a ribbon
core_image: 一排圆键被逐一按下，字杆弹起，在纸上留下一个字母
scene: 旧书房里，桌上摆着一台黑亮的机器，键帽已经磨白。The typewriter still works after a hundred years.
sceneCN: 这里 typewriter 是「打字机」（第 1 个义项：通过按键击打色带在纸上印字的机器）；句意为这台打字机过了一百年仍能使用。字杆弹起、纸上留字的画面，就是这个词的样子。

derivatives.zh: 由 typewriter 反推的动词，义为「用打字机打字」
由 typewrite 加 -ing 构成，义为「打字机打字」
与 typewriter 同族，义为「打字员」

senses.title: The machine on the desk
senses.definition: a machine that prints letters on paper when its keys are struck
senses.definitionCN: 按下按键就能在纸上印出字母的机器
senses.example: The typewriter still works after a hundred years.
senses.exampleCN: 这台打字机过了一百年仍能使用。
senses.why: The word joins what it does: it writes letters of type.
senses.whyCN: 这个词把它的功能直接拼在一起：它写出活字字母。

senses.title: The way of writing it made
senses.definition: the style of writing that such machines produce
senses.definitionCN: 由这类机器产生的书写样式
senses.example: His early scripts were written in typewriter font.
senses.exampleCN: 他早期的剧本用的是打字机字体。
senses.why: A machine leaves its own look on the page, and that look acquired the name too.
senses.whyCN: 机器在纸上留下自己的样子，这种样子也拿到了这个名字。

intro.en: Typewriter is an English compound of type and writer, coined in America in the eighteen sixties.
intro.cn: typewriter 是 type 与 writer 的英语合成词，十九世纪六十年代造于美国。

items.en: Behind type stands typos, a stamp or the mark it leaves.
items.cn: type 背后是 typos，即印模或它留下的痕。

items.en: Typus and scriptor, a writer, meet in the Latin forms of the two halves.
items.cn: 两半的拉丁形式 typus 与 scriptor（书写者）在此相遇。

items.en: Early patents used the word for the person who typed as well as the machine.
items.cn: 早期专利里这个词既指打字的人，也指机器。

items.en: The machine sense won, and offices filled with keys and ribbons.
items.cn: 机器的意义获胜，办公室里满是按键与色带。

items.en: The keyboard survived the typewriter and kept the verb type.
items.cn: 键盘取代了打字机，却留下了动词 type。

note.en: The first group shares the type stem, the second names writing tools.
note.cn: 第一组共享 type 词干，第二组是书写工具。

entries.definition: Writing done on such a machine.
A class, or to press keys.
A machine that puts ink on paper.

normalIntro.en: Typewriter says what it is: a writer of types, letter by letter.
normalIntro.cn: typewriter 说的就是自己：一个写活字的书写者。

normal.en: Two words in one: type plus writer.
normal.cn: 两个词合成一个：type 加 writer。

normal.en: The plural is typewriters, with a single w.
normal.cn: 复数是 typewriters，只有一个 w。

normal.en: A typewriter has a ribbon, not a screen.
normal.cn: 打字机有色带，没有屏幕。

normal.en: The person who uses one is a typist.
normal.cn: 用打字机的人叫 typist。

normal.en: Its hour-long clatter is why writers could hear themselves think.
normal.cn: 它整小时的嗒嗒声，让写作者能听见自己在想什么。

abstract.en: A black machine under a dust cloth.
abstract.cn: 盖着防尘布的一台黑机器。

abstract.en: A bar of letters rising to strike a ribbon.
abstract.cn: 一排字杆扬起击在色带上。

abstract.en: One deep dent left on a sheet of paper.
abstract.cn: 纸页上留下的一处深深凹痕。

examples.en: She bought the typewriter at a street market.
examples.cn: 她在地摊上买下这台打字机。

examples.en: Every letter from the office had a typewriter mark.
examples.cn: 办公室里寄出的每封信都有打字机的凹痕。

examples.en: Computers replaced the typewriter but kept its keyboard.
examples.cn: 电脑取代了打字机，却保留了它的键盘。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太普瑞特」——太普通的一篇文章，也要一个字一个字写出来，靠的是打字机。

root: 由 type（活字，本义为印痕）与 writer（书写者）合成的英语自造词，指用活字逐字击印的机器，同族词有 type、typist、typewriting。

sensesIntro.en: First the machine itself, then the written look it produced.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是机器本身，再是它造出的书写样子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a key pressing a bar against a ribbon.
core.cn: 核心意象：按下键让字杆打在色带上。

branches.en: The machine branch: metal and ink making letters.
branches.cn: 机器分支：金属与油墨造出字母。

branches.en: The style branch: the page keeps the machine's look.
branches.cn: 样式分支：纸页留着机器的样子。

branches.en: The workplace branch: offices run on such pages.
branches.cn: 职场分支：办公室靠这样的纸页运转。

branches.en: The writer branch: authors who type instead of write.
branches.cn: 写作者分支：用打字代替手写的作者。

branches.en: The font branch: a letterform borrowed from the machine.
branches.cn: 字体分支：从机器借来的字体。

intro.en: Typewriter is a two-part compound, and the family grows with -ing and -ist.
intro.cn: typewriter 是双部合成词，词族靠 -ing、-ist 扩展。

latinIntro.en: Its two Latin forebears are typus and scriptor, listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 它的两个拉丁先辈是 typus 与 scriptor，列在下面。

definition_zh: 典型的；有代表性的；特有的
definition_en: showing the usual features of a group, or happening in the usual way
core_image: 一排相似的老房子，其中一栋可以代表整条街
scene: 海边小镇的早晨，渔船一条条回港，街上飘着鱼汤的味道。A typical morning here begins with the boats coming in.
sceneCN: 这里 typical 是「典型的；有代表性的」（第 1 个义项：体现某一类事物共性特征）；句意为这里典型的早晨从渔船回港开始。可以代表整条街的那栋老房子，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 由 typical 加 -ly 构成，义为「典型地；通常」
由 typical 加 -ity 构成，义为「典型性」
由 typical 加前缀 a- 构成，义为「非典型的」

senses.title: The one that stands for all
senses.definition: having the features that most members of a group share
senses.definitionCN: 具有某一群体多数成员共有的特征
senses.example: A typical morning here begins with the boats coming in.
senses.exampleCN: 这里典型的早晨从渔船回港开始。
senses.why: The word points at a sample good enough to stand for the whole group.
senses.whyCN: 这个词指向一个足以代表整群的样本。

senses.title: The habit that marks you
senses.definition: showing the special character of a person or thing, often in a slightly critical way
senses.definitionCN: 显示某人某物特有的性格，常略带批评意味
senses.example: It was typical of him to arrive without calling.
senses.exampleCN: 不打电话就来，正是他一贯的作风。
senses.why: If a feature is shared by a group, it can also be the mark by which one member is known.
senses.whyCN: 若某特征是群体共有，也可成为辨认某个成员的特有标记。

intro.en: Typical is built on type plus the adjective ending -ical, and means of the stamp or the class.
intro.cn: typical 由 type 加形容词词尾 -ical 构成，意为「具有这一印模的」。

items.en: Typos named a blow and the mark left by it.
items.cn: typos 指一击以及它留下的印。

items.en: Typicus appeared in late Latin for something figurative.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 typicus 指具有图像或象征意味的东西。

items.en: The ending -ical joined type to make typical in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 十七世纪 -ical 与 type 结合成 typical。

items.en: Science used it for a specimen that represents a whole species.
items.cn: 科学用它指代表整个物种的标本。

items.en: Everyday speech widened it to anything usual or characteristic.
items.cn: 日常语言把它扩展到一切寻常或有代表性的事物。

note.en: The first group shares the type stem, the second holds words of the same meaning.
note.cn: 第一组共享 type 词干，第二组是同义词。

entries.definition: Typical of a person or thing.

normalIntro.en: Typical means of the type: the sample that wears the class face.
normalIntro.cn: typical 意为「属于这一类的」：长着这一类的脸的样本。

normal.en: Type plus -ical makes the adjective typical.
normal.cn: type 加 -ical 成形容词 typical。

normal.en: Typical of is the set phrase for a characteristic mark.
normal.cn: typical of 是表示「某物特有的」固定搭配。

normal.en: The a- in atypical means not.
normal.cn: atypical 里的 a- 表示「不」。

normal.en: Typically works as a sentence adverb: typically, it rained.
normal.cn: typically 常作句副词：typically, it rained。

normal.en: A typical example is chosen to speak for many.
normal.cn: 典型例子是被选来代表许多个的。

abstract.en: One plain house standing in a row of similar houses.
abstract.cn: 一排相似房屋中一栋普通的房子。

abstract.en: A sample jar labelled to represent a species.
abstract.cn: 标着物种名的标本瓶。

abstract.en: Rain arriving at the same hour every afternoon.
abstract.cn: 每天下午同一时刻到来的雨。

examples.en: This is a typical example of village architecture.
examples.cn: 这是乡村建筑的典型例子。

examples.en: It is typical of her to help without being asked.
examples.cn: 不用人求就帮忙，正是她的作风。

examples.en: Winter here is typical of the whole coast.
examples.cn: 这里的冬天代表了整个海岸一带。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「提皮扣」——提起皮包就能当代表的那一位，最典型。

root: 由 type（类型、印模，源自希腊语 typos 一击与印痕）加形容词词尾 -ical 构成，本义为具有该类特征的，同族词有 typically、typicality、atypical。

sensesIntro.en: First the sample that stands for its class, then the trait that marks an individual.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是能代表类别的样本，再是标记个体的特性。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one plain house that speaks for the row.
core.cn: 核心意象：一间足以代表整排的普通房子。

branches.en: The sample branch: one stands for many.
branches.cn: 样本分支：一个代表许多。

branches.en: The mark branch: the trait that names you.
branches.cn: 标记分支：能叫出你名字的特征。

branches.en: The ordinary branch: nothing unusual happens.
branches.cn: 寻常分支：没有特别的事发生。

branches.en: The judgement branch: typical can gently blame.
branches.cn: 评价分支：常带一点温和的抱怨。

branches.en: The science branch: a specimen defined by its type.
branches.cn: 科学分支：以模式标本定的物种。

intro.en: Typical is type plus -ical, and the family grows with -ly, -ity and the negative a-.
intro.cn: typical 是 type 加 -ical，词族靠 -ly、-ity 与否定前缀 a- 扩展。

latinIntro.en: The late Latin adjective typicus stands behind the English form, listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 英语形式背后是晚期拉丁语形容词 typicus，列在下面。

items.exampleCN: 它构成 typical 与 topical。

definition_en: in the way that is usual for a person, place or kind of thing
core_image: 一份日程表上几乎每天都相同的时刻
scene: 办公室的时钟指向下午，茶水间又排起了队。Typically, the lift is slowest just after lunch.
sceneCN: 这里 typically 是「通常；一般说来」（第 1 个义项：按该类事物常见的做法）；句意为午饭刚过电梯照例最慢。日程表上几乎每天相同的时刻，就是这个词的样子。

derivatives.zh: 由 typically 去掉 -ly 的原形，义为「典型的」
由同一词干加 -ity 构成，义为「典型性」
由 typically 加否定前缀 a- 构成，义为「非典型地」

senses.title: As a rule
senses.definition: in the way that usually happens
senses.definitionCN: 按通常会发生的方式
senses.example: Typically, the lift is slowest just after lunch.
senses.exampleCN: 午饭刚过，电梯照例最慢。
senses.why: The adverb generalises: what is true of the type is expected of the case.
senses.whyCN: 副词做的是普遍化：类型如此，具体一例便可预期如此。

senses.title: In a way that represents
senses.definition: in a way that clearly shows the character of a group
senses.definitionCN: 以清楚体现某群体特征的方式
senses.example: The village looks typically Mediterranean.
senses.exampleCN: 这村子看上去是典型的地中海风格。
senses.why: Instead of pointing at frequency, this use points at how well a feature stands for its class.
senses.whyCN: 这一用法不指向出现频率，而指向某特征代表其类别的贴切程度。

intro.en: Typically is the adverb of typical, carrying the Greek stamp of typos with it.
intro.cn: typically 是 typical 的副词，也带着希腊语 typos 那个印。

items.en: Typos meant a blow and the mark it leaves on a surface.
items.cn: typos 意为击打及其在表面留下的印。

items.en: Typicus gave the adjective; the adverb needed only the English ending -ly.
items.cn: typic(us) 给出形容词，副词只需加英语词尾 -ly。

items.en: Typical appeared first, and typically followed in the eighteenth century.
items.cn: typical 先出现，typically 在十八世纪跟上。

items.en: Writers used it to sum up a habit in one word.
items.cn: 作家用它以一个词概括一种常态。

items.en: Today it opens sentences as a ready-made comment.
items.cn: 今天它常放在句首，作为现成的评语。

note.en: The first group holds adverbs of frequency, the second holds the matching adjective forms.
note.cn: 第一组是频度副词，第二组是对应的形容词。

entries.definition: In a way that marks the person.

normalIntro.en: Typically is typical plus -ly, doing the work of usually with a classier air.
normalIntro.cn: typically 是 typical 加 -ly，做的正是 usually 的活，只是更文雅。

normal.en: Drop -ly and you have the adjective typical.
normal.cn: 去掉 -ly 就是形容词 typical。

normal.en: Coming first in a sentence, it gives a wry comment.
normal.cn: 放在句首时，常带一点无奈的评语意味。

normal.en: Typically before a number means on average.
normal.cn: 在数字前表示平均而言。

normal.en: Compared with usually, it points at the type.
normal.cn: 比起 usually，它更指向「这一类」。

normal.en: The stress stays on the first syllable: TYP-ically.
normal.cn: 重音仍在第一音节。

abstract.en: A clock showing the same time every day.
abstract.cn: 每天都指向同一时刻的钟。

abstract.en: A queue forming at the same door each noon.
abstract.cn: 每天中午在同一扇门前排起的队。

abstract.en: A red roof repeated along one street.
abstract.cn: 一条街上重复出现的红屋顶。

examples.en: Typically, the meeting lasts about forty minutes.
examples.cn: 这种会议通常持续四十分钟左右。

examples.en: The house is typically English, with a small garden.
examples.cn: 这房子是典型的英式，还带个小花园。

examples.en: Such storms typically pass within a day.
examples.cn: 这类风暴一般一天之内就过去。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「提皮扣里」——一提皮扣就能从里翻出代表，典型得很。

root: 由 typical（典型的）加副词词尾 -ly 构成，而 typical 源自希腊语 typos（一击、印痕），本义为按该类特征的样子，同族词有 typical、typicality。

sensesIntro.en: First how things usually go, then how well a case stands for its class.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是事物通常怎样，再是一例怎样代表它那一类。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a schedule repeating the same hour.
core.cn: 核心意象：日程表重复着同一时刻。

branches.en: The rule branch: what usually happens.
branches.cn: 规则分支：通常发生的事。

branches.en: The sample branch: a case that shows the type.
branches.cn: 样本分支：显出类别的例子。

branches.en: The average branch: a figure for the whole.
branches.cn: 平均分支：整体给出的数字。

branches.en: The judgement branch: often said with a raised brow.
branches.cn: 评价分支：常带着挑眉的语气。

branches.en: The habit branch: repetition becomes character.
branches.cn: 习惯分支：重复成了性格。

intro.en: Typically is a root with -ical and -ly stacked on it, a good example of English layering.
intro.cn: typically 是词根上叠了 -ical 与 -ly，正好展示英语的层层相加。

latinIntro.en: The Latin adjective typicus supports the stem, listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁形容词 typicus 支撑着这个词干，列在下面。

definition_en: a person whose job is to type letters or documents
core_image: 一张办公桌前，两只手在键上飞快移动，纸页一节节吐出
scene: 二十世纪的报社办公室，打字声连成一片。The typist finished the letter before noon.
sceneCN: 这里 typist 是「打字员」（第 1 个义项：以打字为职业的人）；句意为打字员在中午前打完了那封信。双手在键上飞快移动的画面，就是这个词的样子。

derivatives.zh: 构成 typist 的动词，义为「打字」
由 type 加 -ing 构成，义为「打字」
与 typist 同族，义为「典型的」

senses.title: The working hands
senses.definition: a person employed to type documents
senses.definitionCN: 受雇专门打文件的人
senses.example: The typist finished the letter before noon.
senses.exampleCN: 打字员在中午前打完了那封信。
senses.why: The suffix -ist names the person, so the word points at a job rather than a skill.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ist 指人，于是这个词指向一份职业而非一门手艺。

senses.title: The quick fingers
senses.definition: anyone who types well, whether paid or not
senses.definitionCN: 无论是否受雇、只要打字熟练的人
senses.example: She is a fast typist for her age.
senses.exampleCN: 就她的年纪而言，她打字很快。
senses.why: When the job faded, the word stayed as a simple description of skill.
senses.whyCN: 当这份职业淡出，词义留了下来，成为对技能的一句描述。

intro.en: Typist is type plus the agent suffix -ist, coined in the eighteen eighties with the typing machine.
intro.cn: typist 是 type 加施动后缀 -ist，随打字机在十九世纪八十年代造出。

items.en: Typos, a stamp or mark, lies behind type.
items.cn: type 背后是 typos，即印模或印记。

items.en: The Latin suffix -ista marked one who follows a practice.
items.cn: 拉丁后缀 -ista 标记从事某种活动的人。

items.en: Typewriter produced both the machine and the person who used it.
items.cn: typewriter 一并产出了机器与使用机器的人。

items.en: Typist was formed to separate the worker from the machine.
items.cn: typist 被造出来，把人与机器分开。

items.en: Offices needed armies of typists until screens replaced paper.
items.cn: 在屏幕取代纸页之前，办公室需要成批的打字员。

note.en: The first group shares the type stem, the second names related office work.
note.cn: 第一组共享 type 词干，第二组是相关办公工作。

entries.definition: An assistant who handles office work.
A person doing routine office work.

normalIntro.en: Typist ends in -ist, the ending that always points at a person.
normalIntro.cn: typist 以 -ist 结尾，这个后缀永远指向一个人。

normal.en: The stress is on the first syllable: TYP-ist.
normal.cn: 重音在第一音节。

normal.en: Type plus -ist makes the job name.
normal.cn: type 加 -ist 便是职业名。

normal.en: A typist types; the typewriter is the machine.
normal.cn: typist 打字的，typewriter 是机器。

normal.en: A shorthand typist took notes and typed them up.
normal.cn: 速记打字员记下来再打出来。

normal.en: The plural is typists, never typistes.
normal.cn: 复数写作 typists。

abstract.en: Two hands hovering over worn round keys.
abstract.cn: 悬在磨旧的圆键上方的一双手。

abstract.en: A stack of letters squared up on one corner.
abstract.cn: 在角上对齐的一叠信。

abstract.en: A chair pulled in close to a narrow desk.
abstract.cn: 拉近窄桌边的那把椅子。

examples.en: The firm employed two typists and one clerk.
examples.cn: 这家公司雇了两名打字员和一名职员。

examples.en: As a typist she is quick and careful.
examples.cn: 作为打字员，她又快又细心。

examples.en: The manuscript was handed to a typist in the evening.
examples.cn: 手稿在傍晚交给了打字员。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太普斯特」——太普通的一份文件，也要靠他一个字一个字敲出来。

root: 由 type（打字，源于希腊语 typos 印痕）加施动后缀 -ist 构成，本义为操作打字机的人，同族词有 typing、typewriter。

sensesIntro.en: First the paid worker in an office, then anyone whose fingers are quick on keys.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是办公室里的专职人员，再是任何打字快手。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands at speed above worn keys.
core.cn: 核心意象：磨旧键上方飞快的一双手。

branches.en: The job branch: paid to make clean pages.
branches.cn: 职业分支：受雇做出干净的纸页。

branches.en: The skill branch: speed survives the machine.
branches.cn: 技能分支：机器没了，速度还在。

branches.en: The office branch: typing rooms full of noise.
branches.cn: 办公室分支：满是声响的打字室。

branches.en: The craft branch: accuracy is the real speed.
branches.cn: 手艺分支：准确才是真正的快。

branches.en: The modern branch: everyone is a quick typist now.
branches.cn: 现代分支：如今人人都打得快。

intro.en: Typist is type plus the agent suffix -ist, and the family grows with -ing and -ical.
intro.cn: typist 是 type 加施动后缀 -ist，词族靠 -ing、-ical 扩展。

latinIntro.en: The Latin suffix -ista and the noun typus both feed this word, listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁后缀 -ista 与名词 typus 都喂养这个词，列在下面。

items.exampleCN: 它构成 typist 与 artist。

definition_en: the thick ring of rubber around a wheel that touches the road
core_image: 一只黑色橡胶圈套在轮毂外，纹路深深咬住路面
scene: 修车铺门口，一辆自行车倒扣在地上，后轮被拆了下来。He pumped up the back tyre and set off again.
sceneCN: 这里 tyre 是「轮胎」（第 1 个义项：套在车轮外与地面接触的橡胶圈）；句意为他给后胎打足气又出发了。黑色橡胶圈咬住路面的样子，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: tyre 的美式拼写，义为「轮胎」
由 tyre 加 -ed 构成，义为「装有……轮胎的」
与 tyre 同领域，义为「翻新胎面」

senses.title: The rubber ring
senses.definition: the rubber covering of a wheel that meets the ground
senses.definitionCN: 车轮外与地面接触的橡胶外层
senses.example: He pumped up the back tyre and set off again.
senses.exampleCN: 他给后胎打足气又出发了。
senses.why: The word names the part that meets the road, the only part of the car touching it.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名的是与路相触的那部分，车上唯一贴地的东西。

senses.title: The iron hoop
senses.definition: the metal band once fitted around a wooden wheel
senses.definitionCN: 早期木轮外面箍的金属圈
senses.example: The old cart still had its iron tyres.
senses.exampleCN: 那辆旧车还带着它的铁轮箍。
senses.why: Before rubber, the same word meant the metal band that bound a wooden wheel.
senses.whyCN: 在橡胶之前，这个词指箍住木轮的金属圈。

intro.en: Tyre is a shortened form of attire, because the band was the wheel's clothing.
intro.cn: tyre 是 attire（装束）的缩略，因为这层箍正是车轮的衣着。

items.en: Atirer meant to set in order or equip, and gave English attire.
items.cn: atirer 意为整理、装备，演成英语 attire。

items.en: Attire named what a person or thing was dressed in.
items.cn: attire 指人或物穿戴着的东西。

items.en: In the fifteenth century tire named the iron band that dressed a wheel.
items.cn: 十五世纪时 tire 指给木轮穿衣的那圈铁箍。

items.en: Rubber replaced iron, but the clothing metaphor stayed.
items.cn: 橡胶取代了铁，但「穿衣」的比喻留了下来。

items.en: British spelling kept tyre while American spelling returned to tire.
items.cn: 英式拼写保留 tyre，美式拼写回到 tire。

note.en: The first group collects wheel words, the second collects things that look similar.
note.cn: 第一组收车轮相关词，第二组收形近词。

entries.definition: Having tyres of a stated kind.
The pattern cut into a tyre.

normalIntro.en: Tyre is the wheel's attire: the rubber coat it wears on the road.
normalIntro.cn: tyre 是车轮的 attire：它上路时穿的那件橡胶外套。

normal.en: Tyre is British, tire is American, and both are correct.
normal.cn: tyre 是英式，tire 是美式，都对。

normal.en: A flat tyre loses air, not its shape.
normal.cn: flat tyre 是漏气，并不失形。

normal.en: Spare tyre can mean a roll of fat at the waist.
normal.cn: spare tyre 也可戏指腰间的赘肉。

normal.en: Tyre pressure is measured in bars or pounds.
normal.cn: 胎压用巴或磅计。

normal.en: Tired and tyre differ only in the ending.
normal.cn: tired 与 tyre 只在词尾不同。

abstract.en: A black ring biting the wet road.
abstract.cn: 一只黑圈咬住湿路面。

abstract.en: A bicycle laid upside down for repair.
abstract.cn: 倒扣过来待修的自行车。

abstract.en: A pump hissing at a valve.
abstract.cn: 一个在气门处嘶嘶作响的打气筒。

examples.en: A nail had gone through the front tyre.
examples.cn: 一根钉子扎穿了前胎。

examples.en: Check the tyre pressure before a long drive.
examples.cn: 长途驾驶前先检查胎压。

examples.en: He changed the tyre in the rain.
examples.cn: 他在雨里换了轮胎。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太饿」——太饿了也得把轮胎换上才能上路。

root: 为 attire（装束）的缩略形式，中古英语 tire 本指箍在木轮外的铁圈，后随橡胶轮沿用，同族词有 tire（美式拼写）。

sensesIntro.en: First the rubber ring of today, then the iron hoop of the past.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是今天的橡胶圈，再是旧日的铁箍。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rubber ring gripping a wet road.
core.cn: 核心意象：咬住湿路面的一圈橡胶。

branches.en: The rubber branch: the part that touches ground.
branches.cn: 橡胶分支：唯一触地的那部分。

branches.en: The historic branch: iron dressed wooden wheels.
branches.cn: 历史分支：铁皮给木轮穿衣。

branches.en: The repair branch: flats, pumps and spares.
branches.cn: 维修分支：爆胎、打气与备胎。

branches.en: The binding branch: something wraps the wheel.
branches.cn: 包裹分支：总有东西裹住车轮。

branches.en: The travel branch: no tyre, no journey.
branches.cn: 出行分支：没轮胎就没旅程。

intro.en: Tyre is a clipped noun, with no productive affixes of its own.
intro.cn: tyre 是缩略名词，本身没有能产的词缀。

latinIntro.en: The French source atirer gave both attire and tyre, listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 法语来源 atirer 同时生出 attire 与 tyre，列在下面。

definition_en: in or to a position below something, or below a stated amount
core_image: 一张桌子下面缩着一只躲雨的猫
scene: 雷雨忽至，院子里的人跑进屋，猫却钻进了桌底。The cat slept under the table all afternoon.
sceneCN: 这里 under 是「在……下面」（第 1 个义项：处在某物的下方）；句意为那只猫一下午都睡在桌子下面。桌底下缩着猫的画面，就是这个词的样子。

derivatives.zh: 由 under 加古词尾构成，义为「在……下面」
由 under 与 ground 合成，义为「地下的」
由 under 与 stand 合成，义为「理解」
由 under 与 way 合成，义为「进行中的」

senses.title: Beneath the table
senses.definition: in a position lower than and often covered by something
senses.definitionCN: 处于比某物更低、常被其遮住的位置
senses.example: The cat slept under the table all afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 那只猫一下午都睡在桌子下面。
senses.why: The oldest sense is simply lower and covered, with something above you.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思就是位置更低且被遮住，头顶上还有东西。

senses.title: Below the mark
senses.definition: less than a particular number, age or level
senses.definitionCN: 少于某个数目、年龄或水平
senses.example: Children under twelve travel free.
senses.exampleCN: 十二岁以下儿童免费乘车。
senses.why: Below in space becomes below in amount: the same picture done to a scale.
senses.whyCN: 空间里的「在下」变成数量上的「不到」：同一个图景用在刻度上。

senses.title: Beneath the weight
senses.definition: while being affected by a condition, rule or authority
senses.definitionCN: 处于某种条件、规则或权力的作用之中
senses.example: The bridge is still under repair.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥仍在维修中。
senses.why: Whatever presses down on you from above holds you in its state, so under also marks conditions.
senses.whyCN: 凡从上方压下来的东西都使你处在其状态里，于是 under 也标记处境。

senses.title: Sinking below
senses.definition: in or into a lower position, used without an object
senses.definitionCN: 处于或进入更低的位置，不带宾语
senses.example: The boat went under within minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 船几分钟内就沉了下去。
senses.why: When the object is obvious, the preposition stands alone as an adverb.
senses.whyCN: 当所及之物不言自明时，介词便独自作副词用。

intro.en: Under is a very old Germanic word built on a root that meant beneath or among.
intro.cn: under 是极古老的日耳曼词，词根源意为「在下」或「在其中」。

items.en: The root carried the sense of being lower or in the middle of a group.
items.cn: 词根表达位于更低处或处在群体中间。

items.en: Under worked as preposition and adverb from the earliest texts.
items.cn: under 从最早的文本起就兼作介词与副词。

items.en: It also meant under the rule of someone, as under a king.
items.cn: 它也表示受某人统治，如 under a king。

items.en: The form has changed almost nothing in a thousand years.
items.cn: 一千年来这个词形几乎没变。

items.en: English used it to build hundreds of compounds, from understand to underground.
items.cn: 英语用它造出数百个合成词，从 understand 到 underground。

note.en: The first group shares the old root, the second holds prepositions of position.
note.cn: 第一组共享古老词根，第二组是方位介词。

entries.definition: Lower than, in position or level.

normalIntro.en: Under is the plain word for having something above your head.
normalIntro.cn: under 就是「头顶之上有东西」的朴素说法。

normal.en: Under pairs with over; below pairs with above.
normal.cn: under 与 over 相对，below 与 above 相对。

normal.en: Below often uses a scale, under often uses a cover.
normal.cn: below 常用于刻度，under 常用于遮盖。

normal.en: Under can mean less than: under ten minutes.
normal.cn: under 可表不足：under ten minutes。

normal.en: Dozens of compounds begin with under-.
normal.cn: 大量合成词以 under- 开头。

normal.en: American speech shortens the last vowel to a light er.
normal.cn: 美式口语末元音弱读。

abstract.en: A cat tucked beneath a table leg.
abstract.cn: 一只缩在桌腿下的猫。

abstract.en: A hand pushing a boat below the surface.
abstract.cn: 一只手把船按到水面以下。

abstract.en: A roof slanting over a doorway.
abstract.cn: 斜在门口上方的屋檐。

examples.en: He found his keys under a cushion.
examples.cn: 他在坐垫下面找到了钥匙。

examples.en: The project is still under discussion.
examples.cn: 这个项目仍在讨论之中。

examples.en: Tickets cost under twenty pounds.
examples.cn: 票价不到二十英镑。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺的」——俺的东西总掉在桌子底下，得弯腰去找。

root: 源自中古英语 under、古英语 under，属日耳曼语最古老的方位词，本义为在下方或被遮住，同族词有 underneath、underground、understand。

sensesIntro.en: First below and covered, then below on a scale, then held under a condition, and finally standing alone.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是被遮在下，再是刻度之下，再是受制于某种处境，最后独立成副词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cat beneath a table.
core.cn: 核心意象：桌下的一只猫。

branches.en: The space branch: something above you.
branches.cn: 空间分支：上方有东西。

branches.en: The scale branch: below a number.
branches.cn: 刻度分支：低于某个数。

branches.en: The rule branch: pressed by a condition.
branches.cn: 条件分支：被某种处境压着。

branches.en: The verbless branch: the object drops away.
branches.cn: 独立分支：宾语省略了。

branches.en: The weight branch: cover becomes control.
branches.cn: 压力分支：遮盖变成支配。

intro.en: Under is a free word that also works as a prefix in hundreds of compounds.
intro.cn: under 是自由词，也作前缀出现在数百个合成词中。

latinIntro.en: Latin sub- carries the same meaning and is listed below for comparison.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sub- 承载同样的意思，下面列出以便对照。
